title.raw: 卷六十三 志第三十九 樂三 Volume 63 Treatises 39: Music 3

sentences.zh: 志第三十九 樂三

translations.literal: Treatise 39: Music, Part Three
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 39: Music, Part Three

sentences.zh: ○樂章二

translations.literal: ○ Music Section Two
translations.idiomatic: Music Section Two

sentences.zh: 洪武三年定朝賀樂章。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 3, court congratulation music was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongwu, music for court congratulation ceremonies was established.

sentences.zh: 升殿，奏《飛龍引之曲》。

translations.literal: When ascending the hall, "Melody of the Soaring Dragon Prelude" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On ascending the hall, they played "Melody of the Soaring Dragon Prelude."

sentences.zh: 百官行禮，奏《風雲會之曲》。

translations.literal: When the hundred officials performed obeisance, "Melody of the Gathering of Wind and Clouds" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the officials performed obeisance, they played "Melody of the Gathering of Wind and Clouds."

sentences.zh: 丞相致詞，奏《慶皇都之曲》。

translations.literal: When the chief minister delivered his address, "Melody of Celebrating the Imperial Capital" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the chief minister delivered his address, they played "Melody of Celebrating the Imperial Capital."

sentences.zh: 復位，百官行禮，奏《喜昇平之曲》。

translations.literal: When returning to position and the hundred officials performed obeisance, "Melody of Rejoicing in Ascending Peace" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to position, when the officials again performed obeisance, they played "Melody of Rejoicing in Ascending Peace."

sentences.zh: 還宮，奏《賀聖朝之曲》。

translations.literal: When returning to the palace, "Melody of Congratulating the Holy Dynasty" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the palace, they played "Melody of Congratulating the Holy Dynasty."

sentences.zh: 俱見後宴饗九奏中。

translations.literal: All are found later among the nine pieces of banquet music.
translations.idiomatic: All of these appear later among the nine banquet pieces.

sentences.zh: 二十六年更定。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year it was revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the regulations were revised.

sentences.zh: 升殿，韶樂，奏《聖安之曲》：乾坤日月明，八方四海慶太平。

translations.literal: When ascending the hall, shao music; "Melody of Sacred Peace" was performed: Heaven and earth, sun and moon shine bright; the eight directions and four seas celebrate great peace.
translations.idiomatic: On ascending the hall, with shao music they played "Melody of Sacred Peace": "Heaven and earth, sun and moon shine bright; the eight directions and four seas celebrate great peace."

sentences.zh: 龍樓鳳閣中，扇開簾卷帝王興。

translations.literal: Within the dragon tower and phoenix pavilion, fans open and curtains roll up as the emperor rises.
translations.idiomatic: Within the dragon tower and phoenix pavilion, fans open and curtains roll up as the emperor takes his place.

sentences.zh: 聖感天地靈，保萬壽，洪福增。

translations.literal: The sage moves heaven and earth spirits; may he preserve ten thousand years; great blessings increase.
translations.idiomatic: The sage moves the spirits of heaven and earth; may he live ten thousand years; may great blessings multiply.

sentences.zh: 祥光王氣生，升寶位，永康寧。

translations.literal: Auspicious light and royal qi arise; he ascends the precious throne; eternal peace and tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious light and royal aura arise; he ascends the precious throne to eternal peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 還宮，韶樂，奏《定安之曲》：九五飛聖龍，千邦萬國敬依從。

translations.literal: When returning to the palace, shao music; "Melody of Settled Peace" was performed: the Nine-Five soars as a sacred dragon; a thousand states and ten thousand nations reverently follow.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the palace, with shao music they played "Melody of Settled Peace": "The Nine-Five soars as a sacred dragon; a thousand states and ten thousand nations reverently follow."

sentences.zh: 鳴鞭三下同，公卿環珮響玎東，掌扇護御容。

translations.literal: The whip sounded three times and all descended; dukes and ministers' girdle pendants chimed; ceremonial fans guarded the imperial countenance.
translations.idiomatic: The whip sounded three times and all bowed down; the jade pendants of dukes and ministers chimed; ceremonial fans guarded the emperor's countenance.

sentences.zh: 中和樂，音呂濃，翡翠錦繡，擁還華蓋赴龍宮。

translations.literal: Moderate and harmonious music, tones thick and full; jade-green brocade; borne back under the splendid canopy to the dragon palace.
translations.idiomatic: With moderate and harmonious music, rich in tone, jade-green brocade, they bore him back under the splendid canopy to the dragon palace.

sentences.zh: 公卿入門，奏《治安之曲》：忠良爲股肱，昊天之德承主恩，森羅拱北辰。

translations.literal: When dukes and ministers entered the gate, "Melody of Good Governance" was performed: the loyal and good serve as arms and thighs; the virtue of vast Heaven receives the lord's grace; all arrayed bow toward the North Star.
translations.idiomatic: When dukes and ministers entered the gate, they played "Melody of Good Governance": "The loyal and good serve as arms and thighs; the virtue of vast Heaven receives the lord's grace; all arrayed bow toward the North Star."

sentences.zh: 御爐煙繞奉天門，江山社稷興。

translations.literal: Imperial censer smoke coils around Fengtian Gate; rivers, mountains, and altars of state flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial censer smoke coils around Fengtian Gate; the rivers, mountains, and altars of state flourish.

sentences.zh: 安天下，軍與民，龍虎會風雲。

translations.literal: To settle the realm, army and people, dragons and tigers meet in wind and clouds.
translations.idiomatic: To settle the realm, army and people, dragons and tigers meet in wind and clouds.

sentences.zh: 後不用。

translations.literal: Later it was no longer used.
translations.idiomatic: It was later discontinued.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十六年定中宮正旦、冬至、千秋節朝賀樂章。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 26, music for the inner palace on New Year's Day, the winter solstice, and the Longevity Festival congratulation was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of Hongwu, music for the inner palace's New Year's Day, winter solstice, and Longevity Festival congratulation ceremonies was established.

sentences.zh: 中宮《天香鳳韶之曲》：寶殿光輝晴天映，懸玉鉤珍珠簾櫳，瑤觴舉時簫韶動。

translations.literal: Inner palace, "Melody of Heavenly Fragrance and Phoenix Shao": the precious hall gleams in clear sky; jade hooks and pearl curtains hang; when jade goblets are raised, xiao and shao music stirs.
translations.idiomatic: For the inner palace, "Melody of Heavenly Fragrance and Phoenix Shao": "The precious hall gleams in the clear sky; jade hooks and pearl curtains hang; when jade goblets are raised, xiao and shao music stirs."

sentences.zh: 慶大筵，來儀鳳，昭陽玉帛齊朝貢。

translations.literal: Celebrating the great banquet, the phoenix of coming ceremony arrives; jade and silk from Zhaoyang all pay court tribute together.
translations.idiomatic: Celebrating the great banquet, the ceremonial phoenix arrives; jade and silk from Zhaoyang all pay court tribute together.

sentences.zh: 贊孝慈賢助仁風，歌謠正在昇平中，謹獻上齊天頌。

translations.literal: Praising filial piety and kindness, worthiness assists the wind of benevolence; songs are now in ascending peace; respectfully offering the hymn equaling Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Praising filial piety and kindness, worthiness assists the wind of benevolence; songs are now in ascending peace

sentences.zh: 宣德以後增定慈宮朝賀樂章。

translations.literal: After the Xuande reign, music for congratulation at the Kindness Palace was additionally established.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xuande reign, music for congratulation at the Kindness Palace was additionally established.

sentences.zh: 《天香鳳韶之曲》：龍樓鳳閣彤雲曉，開繡簾天香芬馥，瑤階春暖千花簇。

translations.literal: "Melody of Heavenly Fragrance and Phoenix Shao": dragon tower and phoenix pavilion at rosy-cloud dawn; embroidered curtains open, heavenly fragrance rich; jade steps in spring warmth, a thousand flowers clustered.
translations.idiomatic: "Melody of Heavenly Fragrance and Phoenix Shao": "Dragon tower and phoenix pavilion at rosy-cloud dawn; embroidered curtains open, heavenly fragrance rich; jade steps in spring warmth, a thousand flowers clustered."

sentences.zh: 壽聖母，齊頌祝，御筵奏獻長生曲。

translations.literal: Wishing long life to the holy mother, all praise and bless; at the imperial banquet they play and offer the melody of long life.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing long life to the holy mother, all praise and bless. at the imperial banquet they play and offer the melody of long life.

sentences.zh: 坤道寧品類咸育，和氣四時調玉燭，享萬萬年太平福。

translations.literal: The way of earth is tranquil; all kinds are nourished; harmonious qi in four seasons tunes the jade candle; enjoy ten thousand myriad years of peaceful blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The way of earth is tranquil; all kinds are nourished; harmonious qi through the four seasons tunes the jade candle; enjoy ten thousand myriad years of peaceful blessing.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年定宴饗樂章。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 3, banquet and feast music was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongwu, music for banquets and feasts was established.

sentences.zh: 一奏《起臨濠之曲》，名《飛龍引》：千載中華生聖主，王氣成龍虎。

translations.literal: First piece, "Melody of Setting Out from Linhao," titled "Soaring Dragon Prelude": for a thousand years China bore a sage lord; royal qi formed dragons and tigers.
translations.idiomatic: First piece: "Melody of Setting Out from Linhao," titled "Soaring Dragon Prelude": "For a thousand years China bore a sage lord; royal qi formed dragons and tigers."

sentences.zh: 提劍起淮西，將勇師雄，百戰收強虜。

translations.literal: Drawing sword he rose in west Huai; generals brave, armies mighty; a hundred battles subdued strong foes.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing his sword he rose in west Huai; with brave generals and mighty armies, a hundred battles subdued strong foes.

sentences.zh: 驅馳鞍馬經寒暑，將士同甘苦。

translations.literal: Driving horses through cold and heat, officers and soldiers shared hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Driving horses through cold and heat, officers and soldiers shared hardship alike.

sentences.zh: 次第靜風塵，除暴安民，功業如湯武。

translations.literal: Step by step the dust of war was stilled; removing violence and settling the people; achievements like Tang and Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Step by step the dust of war was stilled; removing violence and settling the people; achievements like those of Tang and Wu.

sentences.zh: 二奏《開太平之曲》，名《風雲會》：玉壘瞰江城，風雲繞帝營。

translations.literal: Second piece, "Melody of Opening Great Peace," titled "Gathering of Wind and Clouds": jade fortress overlooks the river city; wind and clouds encircle the emperor's camp.
translations.idiomatic: Second piece: "Melody of Opening Great Peace," titled "Gathering of Wind and Clouds": "Jade fortress overlooks the river city; wind and clouds encircle the emperor's camp."

sentences.zh: 駕樓船龍虎縱橫，飛砲發機驅六甲，降虜將，勝胡兵。

translations.literal: Manning tower ships, dragons and tigers ranged far and wide; flying cannon and engines drove the six jia; captive generals surrendered; Hu troops were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Manning tower ships, dragons and tigers ranged far and wide; flying cannon and engines drove the six jia; captive generals surrendered and Hu troops were defeated.

sentences.zh: 談笑掣長鯨，三軍勇氣增。

translations.literal: With a laugh reining in the long whale, the three armies' courage increased.
translations.idiomatic: With a laugh reining in the long whale, the three armies' courage swelled.

sentences.zh: 一戎衣，宇宙清寧。

translations.literal: One suit of armor, and the cosmos was clear and tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: One suit of armor, and the cosmos was clear and tranquil.

sentences.zh: 從此華夷歸一統，開帝業，慶昇平。

translations.literal: From then on Chinese and barbarian returned to one rule; the imperial enterprise opened; ascending peace was celebrated.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Chinese and barbarian returned to one rule; the imperial enterprise opened

sentences.zh: 三奏《安建業之曲》。

translations.literal: Third piece, "Melody of Settling Jianye."
translations.idiomatic: Third piece: "Melody of Settling Jianye."

sentences.zh: 名《慶皇都》：虎踞龍蟠佳麗地，真主開基，千載風雲會。

translations.literal: Titled "Celebrating the Imperial Capital": tiger crouches, dragon coils — a fair land; the true lord opened the foundation; a thousand years' gathering of wind and clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Titled "Celebrating the Imperial Capital": "Tiger crouches, dragon coils — a fair land; the true lord opened the foundation; a thousand years' gathering of wind and clouds."

sentences.zh: 十萬雄兵屯鐵騎，臺臣守將皆奔潰。

translations.literal: A hundred thousand fierce troops stationed with iron cavalry; terrace ministers and defending generals all fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred thousand fierce troops stationed with iron cavalry. terrace ministers and defending generals all fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 一洗煩苛施德惠，里巷謳歌，田野騰和氣。

translations.literal: Washing away harsh exactions and bestowing virtue and grace; alleys sang praise; fields brimmed with harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: Washing away harsh exactions and bestowing virtue and grace; alleys sang praise

sentences.zh: 王業弘開千萬世，黎民咸仰雍熙治。

translations.literal: The royal enterprise broadly opened for ten thousand generations; the people all looked up to flourishing harmony in governance.
translations.idiomatic: The royal enterprise broadly opened for ten thousand generations. the people all looked up to flourishing harmony in governance.

sentences.zh: 四奏《削羣雄之曲》，名《喜昇平》：持黃鉞，削平荊楚清吳越。

translations.literal: Fourth piece, "Melody of Cutting Down the Heroes," titled "Rejoicing in Ascending Peace": holding the yellow battle-axe, leveling Jingchu and clearing Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth piece: "Melody of Cutting Down the Heroes," titled "Rejoicing in Ascending Peace": "Holding the yellow battle-axe, leveling Jingchu and clearing Wu and Yue."

sentences.zh: 清吳越，暮秦朝晉，幾多豪傑。

translations.literal: Clearing Wu and Yue; evening Qin, morning Jin — how many heroes there were.
translations.idiomatic: Clearing Wu and Yue. evening Qin, morning Jin — how many heroes there were.

sentences.zh: 幽燕齊魯風塵潔，伊涼蜀隴人心悅。

translations.literal: Youyan, Qi, and Lu — dust of war was cleansed; Yiliang, Shu, and Long — people's hearts rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Youyan, Qi, and Lu — dust of war was cleansed. Yiliang, Shu, and Long — people's hearts rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 人心悅，車書一統，萬方同轍。

translations.literal: Hearts rejoiced; chariots and writing unified; the ten thousand regions shared one track.
translations.idiomatic: Hearts rejoiced; chariots and writing were unified; the ten thousand regions shared one track.

sentences.zh: 五奏《平幽都之曲》，名《賀聖朝》：天運推遷虜運移，王師北討定燕畿。

translations.literal: Fifth piece, "Melody of Pacifying Youdu," titled "Congratulating the Holy Dynasty": heaven's fortune shifted; the barbarians' fortune moved; the royal army marched north and settled Yanji.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth piece: "Melody of Pacifying Youdu," titled "Congratulating the Holy Dynasty": "Heaven's fortune shifted; the barbarians' fortune moved; the royal army marched north and settled Yanji."

sentences.zh: 百年禮樂重興日，四海風雲慶會時。

translations.literal: The day when a hundred years of ritual and music were revived; the time when the four seas' wind and clouds gathered in celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The day when a hundred years of ritual and music were revived. the time when the four seas' wind and clouds gathered in celebration.

sentences.zh: 除暴虐，撫瘡痍，漠南爭睹舊威儀。

translations.literal: Removing cruelty and tyranny, soothing wounds and sores; south of the desert all strove to behold the old majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Removing cruelty and tyranny, soothing wounds and sores. south of the desert all strove to behold the old majesty.

sentences.zh: 君王聖德容降虜，三恪衣冠拜玉墀。

translations.literal: The sovereign's sage virtue embraced surrendered captives; the three ke in court dress bowed on the jade steps.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign's sage virtue embraced surrendered captives. the three ke in court dress bowed on the jade steps.

sentences.zh: 六奏《撫四夷之曲》，名《龍池宴》：海波不動風塵靜，中國有真人。

translations.literal: Sixth piece, "Melody of Pacifying the Four Yi," titled "Dragon Pool Banquet": sea waves unmoved, dust of war stilled; in China there was a true man.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth piece: "Melody of Pacifying the Four Yi," titled "Dragon Pool Banquet": "Sea waves unmoved, dust of war stilled; in China there was a true man."

sentences.zh: 文身交阯，氈裘金齒，重譯來賓。

translations.literal: Tattooed bodies of Jiaozhi, felt robes of Jinci — through repeated translation they came as guests.
translations.idiomatic: Tattooed bodies of Jiaozhi, felt robes of Jinci — through repeated translation they came as guests.

sentences.zh: 奇珍異產，梯山航海，奉表稱臣。

translations.literal: Rare treasures and exotic products; scaling mountains and sailing seas; presenting memorials and declaring themselves subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Rare treasures and exotic products; scaling mountains and sailing seas

sentences.zh: 白狼玄豹，九苞丹鳳，五色麒麟。

translations.literal: White wolves and dark leopards; nine-plumed crimson phoenix; five-colored qilin.
translations.idiomatic: White wolves and dark leopards; nine-plumed crimson phoenix

sentences.zh: 七奏《定封賞之曲》，名《九重歡》：乾坤清廓，論功定賞，策勳封爵。

translations.literal: Seventh piece, "Melody of Fixing Rewards and Enfeoffments," titled "Joy of the Ninefold Heights": heaven and earth cleared and open; discussing merit and fixing rewards; conferring merit and enfeoffing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh piece: "Melody of Fixing Rewards and Enfeoffments," titled "Joy of the Ninefold Heights": "Heaven and earth cleared and open; discussing merit and fixing rewards; conferring merit and enfeoffing ranks."

sentences.zh: 玉帶金符，貂蟬簪珥，形圖麟閣。

translations.literal: Jade belt and gold tally; diao and chan hairpins and earrings; portraits in the Qilin Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Jade belt and gold tally; diao and chan hairpins and earrings

sentences.zh: 奉天洪武功臣，佐興運，文經武略。

translations.literal: Meritorious ministers who aided heaven in great martial achievement; assisted the rising fortune; versed in civil classics and martial strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious ministers who aided heaven in great martial achievement; assisted the rising fortune

sentences.zh: 子子孫孫，尊榮富貴，久長安樂。

translations.literal: Sons and grandsons; honored glory and wealth; long-lasting peace and joy.
translations.idiomatic: Sons and grandsons; honored glory and wealth

sentences.zh: 八奏《大一統之曲》，名《鳳凰吟》：大明天子駕飛龍，開疆宇，定王封。

translations.literal: Eighth piece, "Melody of Great Unity," titled "Phoenix Song": the Great Ming Son of Heaven drives the soaring dragon; opens borders and territories; fixes kingly enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth piece: "Melody of Great Unity," titled "Phoenix Song": "The Great Ming Son of Heaven drives the soaring dragon; opens borders and territories; fixes kingly enfeoffments."

sentences.zh: 江漢遠朝宗，慶四海，車書會同。

translations.literal: Jiang and Han far pay homage; celebrating the four seas; chariots, writing, and customs unite.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Han far pay homage; celebrating the four seas

sentences.zh: 東夷西旅，北戎南越，都入地圖中。

translations.literal: Eastern Yi and western travelers, northern Rong and southern Yue — all entered the maps.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Yi and western travelers, northern Rong and southern Yue — all entered the maps.

sentences.zh: 遐邇暢皇風，億萬載，時和歲豐。

translations.literal: Far and near enjoyed the imperial wind; for a hundred million years; seasons harmonious and years abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Far and near enjoyed the imperial wind; for a hundred million years

sentences.zh: 九奏《守承平之曲》，名《萬年春》：風調雨順遍乾坤，齊慶承平時節。

translations.literal: Ninth piece, "Melody of Guarding Lasting Peace," titled "Ten Thousand Years of Spring": wind harmonious and rain timely throughout heaven and earth; all together celebrate the season of lasting peace.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth piece: "Melody of Guarding Lasting Peace," titled "Ten Thousand Years of Spring": "Wind harmonious and rain timely throughout heaven and earth; all together celebrate the season of lasting peace."

sentences.zh: 玉燭調和甘露降，遠近桑麻相接。

translations.literal: The jade candle harmonized; sweet dew descended; near and far mulberry and hemp met.
translations.idiomatic: The jade candle harmonized; sweet dew descended

sentences.zh: 偃武修文，報功崇德，率土皆臣妾。

translations.literal: Laying aside arms and cultivating culture; reporting merit and honoring virtue; all within the realm were subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Laying aside arms and cultivating culture; reporting merit and honoring virtue

sentences.zh: 山河磐固，萬方黎庶歡悅。

translations.literal: Mountains and rivers firm as rock; the ten thousand regions' common people rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains and rivers firm as rock. the ten thousand regions' common people rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 長想創業艱難，君臣曾共掃四方豪傑。

translations.literal: Long remembering the hardship of founding the enterprise; ruler and ministers once together swept the heroes of the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Long remembering the hardship of founding the enterprise. ruler and ministers once together swept the heroes of the four directions.

sentences.zh: 露宿宵征鞍馬上，歷盡風霜冰雪。

translations.literal: Sleeping in the open, marching by night on horseback; enduring wind, frost, and snow.
translations.idiomatic: Sleeping in the open, marching by night on horseback. enduring wind, frost, and snow.

sentences.zh: 朝野如今，清寧無事，任用須賢哲。

translations.literal: Court and countryside now — clear and tranquil, nothing amiss; employment must be of wise and sagely men.
translations.idiomatic: Court and countryside now — clear and tranquil, nothing amiss. employment must be of wise and sagely men.

sentences.zh: 躬勤節儉，萬年同守王業。

translations.literal: Personally diligent and frugal; for ten thousand years together guarding the royal enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Personally diligent and frugal. for ten thousand years together guarding the royal enterprise.

sentences.zh: 以上九奏，前三奏和緩，中四奏壯烈，後二奏舒長。

translations.literal: Of the above nine pieces, the first three are gentle and moderate, the middle four are bold and fierce, the last two are expansive and prolonged.
translations.idiomatic: Of the above nine pieces, the first three are gentle and moderate, the middle four are bold and fierce, the last two are expansive and prolonged.

sentences.zh: 其曲皆按月律。

translations.literal: Their melodies all follow the monthly pitch standards.
translations.idiomatic: Their melodies all follow the monthly pitch standards.

sentences.zh: 十二月按律樂歌。

translations.literal: Twelve months of music songs according to pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve months of music songs according to pitch.

sentences.zh: 正月太簇，本宮黃鐘商，俗名大石，曲名《萬年春》：奏天承運秉黃麾，志在安民除慝。

translations.literal: First month, taicu; original mode huangzhong shang, common name dashi; melody title "Ten Thousand Years of Spring": playing heaven, receiving the mandate, holding the yellow banner; the aim is to settle the people and remove evil.
translations.idiomatic: First month, taicu; original mode huangzhong shang, common name dashi; melody title "Ten Thousand Years of Spring": "Playing heaven, receiving the mandate, holding the yellow banner; the aim is to settle the people and remove evil."

sentences.zh: 曾睹中天騰王氣，五色虹霓千尺。

translations.literal: Once beheld mid-heaven soaring with royal qi; five-colored rainbow a thousand feet.
translations.idiomatic: Once beheld mid-heaven soaring with royal qi. five-colored rainbow a thousand feet.

sentences.zh: 龍繞兜鍪，神迎艘艦，嘉應非人力。

translations.literal: Dragons coiled around helmets; spirits welcomed the fleet; auspicious responses were not human effort.
translations.idiomatic: Dragons coiled around helmets; spirits welcomed the fleet

sentences.zh: 鳳凰山上，廢雲長繞峯石。

translations.literal: On Phoenix Mountain, abandoned clouds long coiled around peak and stone.
translations.idiomatic: On Phoenix Mountain, abandoned clouds long coiled around peak and stone.

sentences.zh: 天助神武成功，人心效順，所至皆無敵。

translations.literal: Heaven aided divine martial success; people's hearts submitted in effect; wherever he went none could oppose.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven aided divine martial success; people's hearts submitted in effect

sentences.zh: 手握乾符開寶祚，略定山河南北。

translations.literal: Holding the heavenly tally he opened the precious reign; broadly settled the mountains and rivers north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Holding the heavenly tally he opened the precious reign. broadly settled the mountains and rivers north and south.

sentences.zh: 飲馬江淮，列營河漢，四海風波息。

translations.literal: Watering horses on Jiang and Huai; arraying camps on the Milky Way; the four seas' waves and winds ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Watering horses on Jiang and Huai; arraying camps on the Milky Way

sentences.zh: 師雄將猛，萬方齊仰威德。

translations.literal: Armies mighty, generals fierce; the ten thousand regions together looked up to awe-inspiring virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Armies mighty, generals fierce. the ten thousand regions together looked up to awe-inspiring virtue.

sentences.zh: 二月夾鍾，本宮夾鍾宮，俗名中呂，曲名《玉街行》：山林豺虎，中原狐兔，四海英雄無數。

translations.literal: Second month, jiazhong; original mode jiazhong gong, common name zhonglü; melody title "Jade Street Processional": mountain forests — jackals and tigers; central plains — foxes and hares; the four seas' heroes beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiazhong; original mode jiazhong gong, common name zhonglü; melody title "Jade Street Processional": "Mountain forests — jackals and tigers; central plains — foxes and hares; the four seas' heroes beyond count."

sentences.zh: 大明真主起臨濠，震於赫戎衣一怒。

translations.literal: The Great Ming true lord rose at Linhao; awed by his majesty, at one wrath in military garb.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Ming true lord rose at Linhao. awed by his majesty, at one wrath in military garb.

sentences.zh: 星羅玉壘，雲屯鐵騎，一掃乾坤煙霧。

translations.literal: Stars ranged at the jade fortress; clouds massed with iron cavalry; one sweep cleared heaven and earth's mist.
translations.idiomatic: Stars ranged at the jade fortress; clouds massed with iron cavalry

sentences.zh: 黎民重睹太平年，慶萬里山河磐固。

translations.literal: The people again beheld a year of great peace; celebrating ten thousand li of mountains and rivers firm as rock.
translations.idiomatic: The people again beheld a year of great peace. celebrating ten thousand li of mountains and rivers firm as rock.

sentences.zh: 三月姑洗，本宮太簇商，俗名大石，曲名《賀聖朝》：雲氣朝生芒碭間，虹光夜起鳳凰山。

translations.literal: Third month, guxian; original mode taicu shang, common name dashi; melody title "Congratulating the Holy Dynasty": cloud qi at dawn arose between Mang and Dang; rainbow light at night rose on Phoenix Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guxian; original mode taicu shang, common name dashi; melody title "Congratulating the Holy Dynasty": "Cloud qi at dawn arose between Mang and Dang; rainbow light at night rose on Phoenix Mountain."

sentences.zh: 江淮一日真主出，華夏千年正統還。

translations.literal: On Jiang and Huai in one day the true lord appeared; China's thousand-year orthodox line returned.
translations.idiomatic: On Jiang and Huai in one day the true lord appeared; china's thousand-year orthodox line returned.

sentences.zh: 瞻日角，睹天顏，雲龍風虎競追攀。

translations.literal: Gazing at the sun's corner, beholding the heavenly countenance; cloud dragon and wind tiger strove to follow and climb.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the sun's corner, beholding the heavenly countenance. cloud dragon and wind tiger strove to follow and climb.

sentences.zh: 君臣勤苦成王業，王業汪洋被百蠻。

translations.literal: Ruler and ministers toiled and suffered to complete the royal enterprise; the royal enterprise vast and wide covered the hundred barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and ministers toiled and suffered to complete the royal enterprise. the royal enterprise vast and wide covered the hundred barbarians.

sentences.zh: 四月仲呂，本宮無射徵，俗名黃鐘正徵，曲名《喜昇平》：風雲密，濠梁千載真龍出。

translations.literal: Fourth month, zhonglü; original mode wushe zhi, common name huangzhong zheng zhi; melody title "Rejoicing in Ascending Peace": wind and clouds dense; at Haoliang after a thousand years the true dragon emerged.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, zhonglü; original mode wushe zhi, common name huangzhong zheng zhi; melody title "Rejoicing in Ascending Peace": "Wind and clouds dense; at Haoliang after a thousand years the true dragon emerged."

sentences.zh: 真龍出，鯨鯢豺虎，掃除無跡。

translations.literal: The true dragon emerged; whales and crocodiles, jackals and tigers — swept away without trace.
translations.idiomatic: The true dragon emerged. whales and crocodiles, jackals and tigers — swept away without trace.

sentences.zh: 江河從此波濤息，乾坤同慶承平日。

translations.literal: From now on rivers' waves and billows ceased; heaven and earth together celebrated the day of lasting peace.
translations.idiomatic: From now on rivers' waves and billows ceased. heaven and earth together celebrated the day of lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 承平日，華夷萬里，地圖歸一。

translations.literal: The day of lasting peace; Chinese and barbarian for ten thousand li; maps returned to one.
translations.idiomatic: The day of lasting peace; chinese and barbarian for ten thousand li

sentences.zh: 五月蕤賓，本宮姑洗商，俗名中管雙調，曲名《樂清朝》：中原鹿走英雄起，回首四郊多壘。

translations.literal: Fifth month, ruibin; original mode guxian shang, common name zhongguan shuangdiao; melody title "Joyous Qing Dynasty": on the central plains deer ran — heroes arose; looking back, the four suburbs had many ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, ruibin; original mode guxian shang, common name zhongguan shuangdiao; melody title "Joyous Qing Dynasty": "On the central plains deer ran — heroes arose; looking back, the four suburbs had many ramparts."

sentences.zh: 英主倡兵淮水，將士皆雄偉。

translations.literal: The heroic lord raised arms on the Huai River; officers and soldiers were all mighty.
translations.idiomatic: The heroic lord raised arms on the Huai River. officers and soldiers were all mighty.

sentences.zh: 百靈護助人心喜，一呼萬人風靡。

translations.literal: A hundred spirits aided and protected; people's hearts rejoiced; one call and ten thousand men swept like wind.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred spirits aided and protected; people's hearts rejoiced

sentences.zh: 談笑掃除螻蟻，王業從茲始。

translations.literal: With a laugh sweeping away ants; the royal enterprise from this began.
translations.idiomatic: With a laugh sweeping away ants. the royal enterprise from this began.

sentences.zh: 六月林鐘，本宮夾鍾角，俗名中呂角，曲名《慶皇都》：王氣呈祥飛紫鳳，虎嘯龍興，千里旌旗動。

translations.literal: Sixth month, linzhong; original mode jiazhong jue, common name zhonglü jue; melody title "Celebrating the Imperial Capital": royal qi presented auspicious signs, purple phoenix soaring; tiger roar, dragon rise; a thousand li of banners moved.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, linzhong; original mode jiazhong jue, common name zhonglü jue; melody title "Celebrating the Imperial Capital": "Royal qi presented auspicious signs, purple phoenix soaring; tiger roar, dragon rise; a thousand li of banners moved."

sentences.zh: 四海歡呼師旅衆，天戈一指風雲從。

translations.literal: The four seas rejoiced, armies and hosts cheered; at one point of the heavenly halberd wind and clouds followed.
translations.idiomatic: The four seas rejoiced, armies and hosts cheered. at one point of the heavenly halberd wind and clouds followed.

sentences.zh: 將士爭先民樂用，駕御英雄，聖德皆天縱。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers strove to be first; the people gladly served; he drove heroes; sage virtue was all heaven-bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers strove to be first; the people gladly served

sentences.zh: 率土華夷歸職貢，詞臣拜獻河清頌。

translations.literal: All within the realm, Chinese and barbarian, returned to tribute duty; literary officials bowed and offered the hymn of the river cleared.
translations.idiomatic: All within the realm, Chinese and barbarian, returned to tribute duty. literary officials bowed and offered the hymn of the river cleared.

sentences.zh: 七月夷則，本宮南呂商，俗名中管商角，曲名《永太平》：鳳凰佳氣好，王師起義，乾坤初曉。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yize; original mode nanlü shang, common name zhongguan shangjue; melody title "Everlasting Great Peace": phoenix auspicious qi is fine; the royal army raised the righteous cause; heaven and earth at first light.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yize; original mode nanlü shang, common name zhongguan shangjue; melody title "Everlasting Great Peace": "Phoenix auspicious qi is fine; the royal army raised the righteous cause; heaven and earth at first light."

sentences.zh: 淮水西邊，五色慶雲繚繞。

translations.literal: West of the Huai River, five-colored celebratory clouds coiled.
translations.idiomatic: West of the Huai River, five-colored celebratory clouds coiled.

sentences.zh: 三尺龍泉似水，更百萬貔貅熊豹。

translations.literal: A three-foot dragon spring like water; moreover a million brave warriors like bears and leopards.
translations.idiomatic: A three-foot dragon spring like water. moreover a million brave warriors like bears and leopards.

sentences.zh: 軍令悄，魚麗鵝鸛，風雲蛇鳥。

translations.literal: Military orders quiet; fish-scale and goose-and-crane formations; wind, clouds, serpent, and bird.
translations.idiomatic: Military orders quiet; fish-scale and goose-and-crane formations

sentences.zh: 赳赳電掣鷹揚，在伐罪安民，去殘除暴。

translations.literal: Vigorous as lightning and falcon-soaring; in punishing crime and settling the people; removing cruelty and eliminating violence.
translations.idiomatic: Vigorous as lightning and falcon-soaring; in punishing crime and settling the people

sentences.zh: 天與人歸，豪傑削平多少。

translations.literal: Heaven and men returned to him; how many heroes were cut down and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and men returned to him. how many heroes were cut down and pacified.

sentences.zh: 萬里煙塵淨洗，正紅日一輪高照。

translations.literal: Ten thousand li of war dust washed clean; just then one wheel of the red sun shone high.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand li of war dust are washed clean; just then one wheel of the red sun shines high.

sentences.zh: 膺大寶，王業萬年相保。

translations.literal: He received the great treasure; the royal enterprise ten thousand years mutually preserved.
translations.idiomatic: He received the great treasure. the royal enterprise ten thousand years mutually preserved.

sentences.zh: 八月南呂，本宮南呂宮，俗名中管仙呂，曲名《鳳凰吟》：紫微翠蓋擁蓬萊，聖天子，帝圖開。

translations.literal: Eighth month, nanlü; original mode nanlü gong, common name zhongguan xianlü; melody title "Phoenix Song": purple canopy and green parasol embrace Penglai; the sage Son of Heaven; the imperial design opens.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, nanlü; original mode nanlü gong, common name zhongguan xianlü; melody title "Phoenix Song": "Purple canopy and green parasol embrace Penglai; the sage Son of Heaven; the imperial design opens."

sentences.zh: 歷數應江淮，看五色雲生上臺。

translations.literal: The mandate of succession answered to Jiang and Huai; behold five-colored clouds arise on the high terrace.
translations.idiomatic: The mandate of succession answered to Jiang and Huai. behold five-colored clouds arise on the high terrace.

sentences.zh: 櫛風沐雨，攻堅擊銳，將士總英才。

translations.literal: Combing wind and washing rain; attacking strongholds and striking sharp foes; officers and soldiers all outstanding talents.
translations.idiomatic: Combing wind and washing rain; attacking strongholds and striking sharp foes

sentences.zh: 躍馬定塵埃，創萬古山河壯哉。

translations.literal: Leaping horses settled the dust; creating ten thousand ages of mountains and rivers — how majestic!
translations.idiomatic: Leaping horses settled the dust. creating ten thousand ages of mountains and rivers — how majestic!

sentences.zh: 九月無射，本宮無射宮，俗名黃鐘，曲名《飛龍引》，詞同前《起臨濠》之曲。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wushe; original mode wushe gong, common name huangzhong; melody title "Soaring Dragon Prelude"; lyrics same as the earlier "Setting Out from Linhao" piece.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wushe; original mode wushe gong, common name huangzhong

sentences.zh: 十月應鐘，本宮姑洗徵，俗名中呂正徵，曲名《龍池宴》：大明英主承天運，倡義擁天戈。

translations.literal: Tenth month, yingzhong; original mode guxian zhi, common name zhonglü zheng zhi; melody title "Dragon Pool Banquet": the Great Ming heroic lord received heaven's fortune; raised the righteous cause and embraced the heavenly halberd.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yingzhong; original mode guxian zhi, common name zhonglü zheng zhi; melody title "Dragon Pool Banquet": "The Great Ming heroic lord received heaven's fortune; raised the righteous cause and embraced the heavenly halberd."

sentences.zh: 星辰旋繞，風雲圍護，龍虎麾訶。

translations.literal: Stars and constellations revolved around; wind and clouds surrounded and guarded; dragons and tigers commanded and directed.
translations.idiomatic: Stars and constellations revolved around; wind and clouds surrounded and guarded

sentences.zh: 旌旗所指，羌夷納款，江海停波。

translations.literal: Wherever banners and flags pointed, Qiang and Yi submitted; rivers and seas ceased their waves.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever banners and flags pointed, Qiang and Yi submitted. rivers and seas ceased their waves.

sentences.zh: 從今平定，萬年疆宇，百二山河。

translations.literal: From now pacified and settled; ten thousand years of territory; the hundred-and-two mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: From now pacified and settled; ten thousand years of territory

sentences.zh: 十一月黃鐘，本宮夷則角，俗名仙呂角，曲名《金門樂》：慶皇明聖主開寶祚，起臨濠。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, huangzhong; original mode yize jue, common name xianlü jue; melody title "Golden Gate Joy": celebrating the sage lord of brilliant Ming opening the precious reign; rising at Linhao.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, huangzhong; original mode yize jue, common name xianlü jue; melody title "Golden Gate Joy": "Celebrating the sage lord of brilliant Ming opening the precious reign; rising at Linhao."

sentences.zh: 正汝潁塵飛，江淮浪卷，赤子呼號。

translations.literal: Just then dust flew on Ru and Ying; waves rolled on Jiang and Huai; infants cried out.
translations.idiomatic: Just then dust flew on Ru and Ying; waves rolled on Jiang and Huai

sentences.zh: 天戈奮然倡義，擁神兵百萬總英豪。

translations.literal: The heavenly halberd vigorously raised the righteous cause; embracing divine troops, a million in all, outstanding heroes.
translations.idiomatic: The heavenly halberd vigorously raised the righteous cause. embracing divine troops, a million in all, outstanding heroes.

sentences.zh: 貔虎朝屯壁壘，虹霓夜繞弓刀。

translations.literal: Brave tigers by day massed at ramparts; rainbow by night coiled around bow and blade.
translations.idiomatic: Brave tigers by day massed at ramparts. rainbow by night coiled around bow and blade.

sentences.zh: 鳳凰同勢聳層霄，佳氣五雲高。

translations.literal: Phoenix and tung tree alike soared to layered skies; auspicious qi, five clouds high.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix and tung tree alike soared to layered skies. auspicious qi, five clouds high.

sentences.zh: 愛士伍同心，君臣協力，不憚勤勞。

translations.literal: Loving officers and soldiers, sharing one heart; ruler and ministers cooperating; not fearing toil.
translations.idiomatic: Loving officers and soldiers, sharing one heart; ruler and ministers cooperating

sentences.zh: 風雲一時相會，看魚龍飛舞出波濤。

translations.literal: Wind and clouds for a time met together; behold fish and dragon flying and dancing out of the waves.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and clouds for a time met together. behold fish and dragon flying and dancing out of the waves.

sentences.zh: 靜掃八方氛祲，咸聽九奏簫韶。

translations.literal: Quietly sweeping the eight directions' baleful vapors; all heard the nine performances of xiao and shao.
translations.idiomatic: Quietly sweeping the eight directions' baleful vapors. all heard the nine performances of xiao and shao.

sentences.zh: 十二月大呂，本宮大呂宮，俗名高宮，曲名《風雲會》：天眷顧淮西，真人起布衣，正乾剛九五龍飛。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dalü; original mode dalü gong, common name gaogong; melody title "Gathering of Wind and Clouds": heaven favored and looked to west Huai; the true man rose from common cloth; just then qian gang, nine-five, the dragon flew.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dalü; original mode dalü gong, common name gaogong; melody title "Gathering of Wind and Clouds": "Heaven favored and looked to west Huai; the true man rose from common cloth; just then qian gang, nine-five, the dragon flew."

sentences.zh: 駕馭英雄收俊傑，承永命，布皇威。

translations.literal: Driving heroes, gathering outstanding talents; receiving the eternal mandate; spreading imperial awe.
translations.idiomatic: Driving heroes, gathering outstanding talents; receiving the eternal mandate

sentences.zh: 一劍立鴻基，三軍擁義旗，望雲霓四海人歸。

translations.literal: One sword established the great foundation; the three armies embraced the banner of righteousness; gazing at rainbow clouds, the people of the four seas returned.
translations.idiomatic: One sword established the great foundation; the three armies embraced the banner of righteousness

sentences.zh: 整頓乾坤除暴虐，歌聖德，慶雍熙。

translations.literal: Putting in order heaven and earth, removing cruelty and tyranny; singing the sage's virtue; celebrating flourishing harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Putting in order heaven and earth, removing cruelty and tyranny; singing the sage's virtue

sentences.zh: 武舞曲，名《清海宇》：拔劍起淮土，策馬定寰區。

translations.literal: Martial dance music, titled "Clearing the Seas and Universe": drawing sword he rose on Huai soil; spurring horses he settled the whole realm.
translations.idiomatic: Martial dance music, titled "Clearing the Seas and Universe": "Drawing sword he rose on Huai soil; spurring horses he settled the whole realm."

sentences.zh: 王氣開天統，寶曆應乾符。

translations.literal: Royal qi opened the heavenly succession; the precious calendar answered to the qian tally.
translations.idiomatic: Royal qi opened the heavenly succession. the precious calendar answered to the qian tally.

sentences.zh: 武略文謨，龍虎風雲創業初。

translations.literal: Martial strategy and civil plans; dragons, tigers, wind and clouds at the founding's beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Martial strategy and civil plans. dragons, tigers, wind and clouds at the founding's beginning.

sentences.zh: 將軍星繞弁，勇士月彎弧。

translations.literal: General stars coiled around caps; brave warriors' moons bent bows.
translations.idiomatic: General stars coiled around caps. brave warriors' moons bent bows.

sentences.zh: 選騎平南楚，結陣下東吳，跨蜀驅胡，萬里山河壯帝居。

translations.literal: Selecting cavalry to pacify south Chu; forming battle lines to descend on east Wu; crossing Shu and driving off Hu; ten thousand li of mountains and rivers glorify the emperor's dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: Selecting cavalry to pacify south Chu; forming battle lines to descend on east Wu

sentences.zh: 文舞曲，名《泰階平》：乾坤清寧，治功告成，武定禍亂，文致太平。

translations.literal: Civil dance music, titled "Great Steps Pacified": heaven and earth clear and tranquil; governing achievements announced complete; martial power settled calamity and disorder; civil culture brought great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Civil dance music, titled "Great Steps Pacified": "Heaven and earth clear and tranquil; governing achievements announced complete; martial power settled calamity and disorder; civil culture brought great peace."

sentences.zh: 郊則致其禮，廟則盡其誠。

translations.literal: At the suburban altar then offering its rites; at the temple then exhausting its sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban altar then offering its rites. at the temple then exhausting its sincerity.

sentences.zh: 卿雲在天甘露零，風雨時若百穀登。

translations.literal: Auspicious clouds in heaven, sweet dew descends; wind and rain timely, the hundred grains rise.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious clouds in heaven, sweet dew descends. wind and rain timely, the hundred grains rise.

sentences.zh: 禮樂雍和，政刑肅清。

translations.literal: Ritual and music harmonious; government and punishments solemn and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual and music harmonious. government and punishments solemn and clear.

sentences.zh: 儲嗣既立，封建乃行。

translations.literal: The heir apparent already established; enfeoffment then carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent already established. enfeoffment then carried out.

sentences.zh: 讒佞屏四海，賢俊立朝廷。

translations.literal: Slanderers and flatterers barred from the four seas; worthy and outstanding men stood at court.
translations.idiomatic: Slanderers and flatterers barred from the four seas. worthy and outstanding men stood at court.

sentences.zh: 玉帛鐘鼓陳兩楹，君臣賡歌揚頒聲。

translations.literal: Jade and silk, bells and drums arrayed in the two rows; ruler and ministers continuing songs, raising the sound of proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silk, bells and drums arrayed in the two rows. ruler and ministers continuing songs, raising the sound of proclamation.

sentences.zh: 四夷舞曲，其一，《小將軍》：大明君，定宇寰，聖恩寬，掌江山，東虜西戎，北狄南蠻，手高擎，寶貝盤。

translations.literal: Four Yi dance music, first, "Little General": Great Ming lord, settling the universe; sage grace broad; holding rivers and mountains; eastern captives, western Rong, northern Di, southern Man — in hand high raised, the treasure tray.
translations.idiomatic: Four Yi dance music, first, "Little General": "Great Ming lord, settling the universe; sage grace broad; holding rivers and mountains; eastern captives, western Rong, northern Di, southern Man — in hand high raised, the treasure tray."

sentences.zh: 其二，《殿前歡》：五雲宮闕連霄漢，金光明照眼。

translations.literal: Second, "Hall Delight": five-cloud palace towers link to the Milky Way; golden light bright shines on the eyes.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Hall Delight": "Five-cloud palace towers link to the Milky Way; golden light bright shines on the eyes."

sentences.zh: 玉溝金水聲潺潺，頫囟觀，趨蹌看，儀鑾嚴肅百千般，威人心膽寒。

translations.literal: Jade moat and golden water sound murmuring; bowing the head to observe; hurrying to look; ceremonial guards solemn in a hundred aspects; awe makes hearts and gall cold.
translations.idiomatic: Jade moat and golden water sound murmuring; bowing the head to observe

sentences.zh: 其三，《慶新年》：虎豹關，文武班，五彩間慶雲朝霞燦。

translations.literal: Third, "Celebrating the New Year": tiger and leopard pass; civil and military ranks; between five colors celebratory clouds and dawn radiance blaze.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "Celebrating the New Year": "Tiger and leopard pass; civil and military ranks; between five colors celebratory clouds and dawn radiance blaze."

sentences.zh: 黃金殿，喜氣增，丹墀內，仰聖顏。

translations.literal: Golden hall; joyous qi increases; within the cinnabar steps; looking up at the sage countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Golden hall; joyous qi increases

sentences.zh: 翠繞紅圍錦繡班，高樓十二欄。

translations.literal: Green coiling, red surrounding, brocade ranks; high towers, twelve balustrades.
translations.idiomatic: Green coiling, red surrounding, brocade ranks. high towers, twelve balustrades.

sentences.zh: 笙簫趁紫壇，仙音韻，瑤闉按，拜舞齊，歌謠纘，吾皇萬壽安。

translations.literal: Sheng and xiao follow the purple altar; immortal music's charm; jade door-bar pressed; bowing dance together; songs and ballads continue; may our emperor ten thousand years be at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng and xiao follow the purple altar; immortal music's charm

sentences.zh: 其四，《過門子》：定宇寰，定宇寰，掌江山，撫百蠻。

translations.literal: Fourth, "Passing the Gate": settling the universe, settling the universe; holding rivers and mountains; soothing the hundred barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, "Passing the Gate": "Settling the universe, settling the universe; holding rivers and mountains; soothing the hundred barbarians."

sentences.zh: 謳歌拜舞仰祝纘，萬萬年，帝業安。

translations.literal: Songs of praise, bowing dance looking up to continue blessing; ten thousand myriad years; the imperial enterprise secure.
translations.idiomatic: Songs of praise, bowing dance looking up to continue blessing; ten thousand myriad years

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年重定宴饗九奏樂章。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 15 the nine banquet pieces of music were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu the nine banquet pieces of music were revised.

sentences.zh: 一奏《炎精開運之曲》：炎精開運，篤生聖皇。

translations.literal: First piece, "Melody of the Fiery Essence Opening Fortune": the fiery essence opens fortune; sincerely born is the sage emperor.
translations.idiomatic: First piece, "Melody of the Fiery Essence Opening Fortune": "The fiery essence opens fortune; sincerely born is the sage emperor."

sentences.zh: 大明御極，遠紹虞唐。

translations.literal: Great Ming ascends the pinnacle; far inheriting Yu and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Great Ming ascends the pinnacle. far inheriting Yu and Tang.

sentences.zh: 河清海宴，物阜民康。

translations.literal: The river clear, the sea calm; things abundant, the people at ease.
translations.idiomatic: The river clear, the sea calm. things abundant, the people at ease.

sentences.zh: 威加夷僚，德被戎羌。

translations.literal: Awe reaching the Yi borderlands; virtue covering the Rong and Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Awe reaching the Yi borderlands. virtue covering the Rong and Qiang.

sentences.zh: 八珍有薦，九鼎馨香。

translations.literal: Eight delicacies are offered; nine tripods fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Eight delicacies are offered. nine tripods fragrant.

sentences.zh: 鼓鍾鐄鐄，宮徵洋洋。

translations.literal: Drums and bells booming; gong and zhi notes vast.
translations.idiomatic: Drums and bells booming. gong and zhi notes vast.

sentences.zh: 怡神養壽，理陰順陽。

translations.literal: Cheering the spirit, nurturing longevity; regulating yin and following yang.
translations.idiomatic: Cheering the spirit, nurturing longevity. regulating yin and following yang.

sentences.zh: 保茲遐福，地久天長。

translations.literal: Preserve this distant blessing; earth long-lasting, heaven long-lasting.
translations.idiomatic: Preserve this distant blessing. earth long-lasting, heaven long-lasting.

sentences.zh: 二奏《皇風之曲》：皇風被八表，熙熙聲教宣。

translations.literal: Second piece, "Melody of Imperial Wind": imperial wind covers the eight regions; prosperous, the sound of teaching is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Second piece, "Melody of Imperial Wind": "Imperial wind covers the eight regions; prosperous, the sound of teaching is proclaimed."

sentences.zh: 時和景象明，紫宸開繡筵。

translations.literal: Seasons harmonious, the scene bright; the Purple Forbidden opens the embroidered banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Seasons harmonious, the scene bright. the Purple Forbidden opens the embroidered banquet.

sentences.zh: 龍袞曜朝日，金爐嫋祥煙。

translations.literal: Dragon robes shine in the morning sun; golden censers curl auspicious smoke.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon robes shine in the morning sun. golden censers curl auspicious smoke.

sentences.zh: 濟濟公與侯，被服麗且鮮。

translations.literal: Numerous dukes and marquises; robes splendid and fresh.
translations.idiomatic: Numerous dukes and marquises. robes splendid and fresh.

sentences.zh: 列坐侍丹扆，磬折在周旋。

translations.literal: Arranged in seats serving the cinnabar screen; bowing like stone chimes in circling.
translations.idiomatic: Arranged in seats serving the cinnabar screen. bowing like stone chimes in circling.

sentences.zh: 羔豚昇華俎，玉饌充方圓。

translations.literal: Lamb and pigkin ascend the splendid tray; jade delicacies fill square and round.
translations.idiomatic: Lamb and pigkin ascend the splendid tray. jade delicacies fill square and round.

sentences.zh: 初筵奏《南風》，繼歌賡載篇。

translations.literal: At the first banquet "Southern Winds" is performed; continuing songs carry on the pieces.
translations.idiomatic: At the first banquet "Southern Winds" is performed. continuing songs carry on the pieces.

sentences.zh: 瑤觴欣再舉，拜俯禮無愆。

translations.literal: Jade goblets gladly raised again; bowing low, rites without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Jade goblets gladly raised again. bowing low, rites without fault.

sentences.zh: 同樂及斯辰，於皇千萬年。

translations.literal: Together rejoicing reaches this day; O august one, ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Together rejoicing reaches this day; o august one, ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 奏《平定天下之舞》，曲名《清海宇》。

translations.literal: Performed "Dance of Pacifying the Realm"; melody title "Clearing the Seas and Universe."
translations.idiomatic: Performed "Dance of Pacifying the Realm". melody title "Clearing the Seas and Universe."

sentences.zh: 同前。

translations.literal: Same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Same as before.

sentences.zh: 三奏《眷皇明之曲》：赫赫上帝，眷我皇明。

translations.literal: Third piece, "Melody of Cherishing Brilliant Ming": majestic majestic Supreme God cherishes our brilliant Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Third piece, "Melody of Cherishing Brilliant Ming": "Majestic majestic Supreme God cherishes our brilliant Ming."

sentences.zh: 大命既集，本固支榮。

translations.literal: The great mandate already gathered; the root firm, branches flourish.
translations.idiomatic: The great mandate already gathered. the root firm, branches flourish.

sentences.zh: 厥本伊何？

translations.literal: Its root — what is it?
translations.idiomatic: Its root — what is it?

sentences.zh: 育德春宮。

translations.literal: Nurturing virtue in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Nurturing virtue in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 厥支伊何？

translations.literal: Its branches — what are they?
translations.idiomatic: Its branches — what are they?

sentences.zh: 籓邦以寧。

translations.literal: Feudal states thereby tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Feudal states thereby tranquil.

sentences.zh: 慶延百世，澤被羣生。

translations.literal: Blessing extended a hundred generations; grace covering the multitude of living beings.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing extended a hundred generations. grace covering the multitude of living beings.

sentences.zh: 及時爲樂，天祿是膺。

translations.literal: Timely taking joy; heaven's emolument is received.
translations.idiomatic: Timely taking joy. heaven's emolument is received.

sentences.zh: 千秋萬歲，永觀厥成。

translations.literal: A thousand autumns, ten thousand years; forever behold its completion.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand autumns, ten thousand years. forever behold its completion.

sentences.zh: 奏《撫安四夷之舞》，曲名《小將軍》、《殿前歡》、《慶新年》、《過門子》。

translations.literal: Performed "Dance of Pacifying the Four Yi"; melody titles "Little General," "Hall Delight," "Celebrating the New Year," "Passing the Gate."
translations.idiomatic: Performed "Dance of Pacifying the Four Yi". melody titles "Little General," "Hall Delight," "Celebrating the New Year," "Passing the Gate."

sentences.zh: 俱同前。

translations.literal: All same as before.
translations.idiomatic: All same as before.

sentences.zh: 四奏《天道傳之曲》：馬負圖兮天道傳，龜載書兮人文宣。

translations.literal: Fourth piece, "Melody of Heaven's Way Transmitted": the horse bore the diagram — heaven's way transmitted; the tortoise bore the writing — human culture proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth piece, "Melody of Heaven's Way Transmitted": "The horse bore the diagram — heaven's way transmitted; the tortoise bore the writing — human culture proclaimed."

sentences.zh: 羲畫卦兮禹疇敘，皇極建兮合自然。

translations.literal: Xi drew the hexagrams; Yu arranged the categories; the supreme pole established — joining natural order.
translations.idiomatic: Xi drew the hexagrams; yu arranged the categories

sentences.zh: 綿綿歷數歸明主，祥麟在郊威鳳舞。

translations.literal: Continuously the mandate of succession returned to the bright lord; auspicious qilin in the suburbs, awesome phoenix dancing.
translations.idiomatic: Continuously the mandate of succession returned to the bright lord. auspicious qilin in the suburbs, awesome phoenix dancing.

sentences.zh: 九夷入貢康衢謠，聖子神孫繼祖武，垂拱無爲邁前古。

translations.literal: The nine Yi entered tribute on the Kangshu road's song; sage son and divine grandson continued ancestral martial prowess; hands folded, doing nothing, surpassing former antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The nine Yi entered tribute on the Kangshu road's song; sage son and divine grandson continued ancestral martial prowess

sentences.zh: 奏《車書會同之舞》，曲名《泰階平》。

translations.literal: Performed "Dance of Chariots and Writing United"; melody title "Great Steps Pacified."
translations.idiomatic: Performed "Dance of Chariots and Writing United". melody title "Great Steps Pacified."

sentences.zh: 同前

translations.literal: Same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Same as before.

sentences.zh: 五奏《振皇綱之曲》：《周南》詠麟趾，《卷阿》歌鳳凰。

translations.literal: Fifth piece, "Melody of Stirring the Imperial Net": "Zhou South" sings the qilin's hoof; "Juan E" sings the phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth piece, "Melody of Stirring the Imperial Net": "Zhou South" sings the qilin's hoof. "Juan E" sings the phoenix.

sentences.zh: 藹藹稱多士，爲楨振皇綱。

translations.literal: Numerous, they are called many scholars; as cornerposts stirring the imperial net.
translations.idiomatic: Numerous, they are called many scholars. as cornerposts stirring the imperial net.

sentences.zh: 赫赫我大明，德尊逾漢唐。

translations.literal: Majestic majestic our Great Ming; virtue honored surpassing Han and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Majestic majestic our Great Ming. virtue honored surpassing Han and Tang.

sentences.zh: 百揆修庶績，公輔理陰陽。

translations.literal: The hundred offices cultivate the multitude of achievements; dukes and assistants regulate yin and yang.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred offices cultivate the multitude of achievements. dukes and assistants regulate yin and yang.

sentences.zh: 峨冠正襟佩，都俞在高堂，坐令八紘內，熙熙民樂康。

translations.literal: High caps, straight collars, girdle ornaments; yes and nay in the high hall; sitting to make within the eight cords prosperous, the people joyful and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: High caps, straight collars, girdle ornaments; yes and nay in the high hall

sentences.zh: 氣和風雨時，田疇歲豐穰。

translations.literal: Qi harmonious, wind and rain timely; fields and plots yearly abundant harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Qi harmonious, wind and rain timely. fields and plots yearly abundant harvest.

sentences.zh: 獻禮過三爵，歡娛良未央。

translations.literal: Offering rites past three toasts; rejoicing and pleasure truly without end.
translations.idiomatic: Offering rites past three toasts. rejoicing and pleasure truly without end.

sentences.zh: 六奏《金陵之曲》：鐘山蟠蒼龍，石城踞金虎。

translations.literal: Sixth piece, "Melody of Jinling": Bell Mountain coils like an azure dragon; Stone City crouches like a golden tiger.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth piece, "Melody of Jinling": "Bell Mountain coils like an azure dragon; Stone City crouches like a golden tiger."

sentences.zh: 千年王氣都，於今歸聖主。

translations.literal: A thousand years of royal qi all; now it returns to the sage lord.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand years of royal qi all. now it returns to the sage lord.

sentences.zh: 六代繁華經幾秋，江流東去無時休。

translations.literal: Six dynasties' splendor passed how many autumns; the river flows east without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Six dynasties' splendor passed how many autumns. the river flows east without cease.

sentences.zh: 誰言天塹分南北，英雄豈但嗤曹劉。

translations.literal: Who says the heavenly moat divides north and south? Heroes are not merely to scoff at Cao and Liu.
translations.idiomatic: Who says the heavenly moat divides north and south? Heroes are not merely to scoff at Cao and Liu.

sentences.zh: 我皇昔住濠梁屋，神遊天錫真人服，提兵乘勢渡江來，語臣早獻《金陵曲》。

translations.literal: Our emperor once dwelt in a house at Haoliang; spirit wandering, heaven bestowed the true man's garb; raising troops riding the momentum crossing the river to come; telling his ministers early to present "Melody of Jinling."
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor once dwelt in a house at Haoliang; spirit wandering, heaven bestowed the true man's garb

sentences.zh: 歌金陵，進珍饌，皆八音，繼三嘆。

translations.literal: Singing Jinling, advancing rare delicacies; all eight tones; continuing three sighs.
translations.idiomatic: Singing Jinling, advancing rare delicacies; all eight tones

sentences.zh: 請觀漢祖用兵時，爲嘗馮異滹沱飯。

translations.literal: Please observe when Han's founder used troops; he once gave Feng Yi food at the Hutuo.
translations.idiomatic: Please observe when Han's founder used troops. he once gave Feng Yi food at the Hutuo.

sentences.zh: 七奏《長楊之曲》：長楊曳綠，黃鳥和鳴。

translations.literal: Seventh piece, "Melody of Long Poplar": long poplar trailing green; yellow birds harmoniously calling.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh piece, "Melody of Long Poplar": "Long poplar trailing green; yellow birds harmoniously calling."

sentences.zh: 菡萏呈鮮，紫燕輕盈。

translations.literal: Lotus blooms fresh; purple swallows light and graceful.
translations.idiomatic: Lotus blooms fresh. purple swallows light and graceful.

sentences.zh: 千花浥露，日麗風清。

translations.literal: A thousand flowers bathed in dew; sun beautiful, wind clear.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand flowers bathed in dew. sun beautiful, wind clear.

sentences.zh: 及時爲樂，芳尊在庭。

translations.literal: Timely taking joy; fragrant goblets in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Timely taking joy. fragrant goblets in the hall.

sentences.zh: 管音嘒嘒，絲韻泠泠，玉振金聲，各奏爾能。

translations.literal: Pipe notes clear and sharp; silk charm cold and clear; jade vibration, gold sound; each displays your ability.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe notes clear and sharp; silk charm cold and clear

sentences.zh: 皤皤國老，載勸載懲。

translations.literal: Hoary state elders; bearing admonition, bearing caution.
translations.idiomatic: Hoary state elders. bearing admonition, bearing caution.

sentences.zh: 明德惟馨，垂之聖經。

translations.literal: Bright virtue alone is fragrant; handed down in the sage classics.
translations.idiomatic: Bright virtue alone is fragrant. handed down in the sage classics.

sentences.zh: 《唐風》示戒，永保嘉名。

translations.literal: "Tang Winds" shows warning; forever preserve the fine name.
translations.idiomatic: "Tang Winds" shows warning. forever preserve the fine name.

sentences.zh: 無已太康，哲人是聽。

translations.literal: Do not pursue excessive great peace; the wise man is heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Do not pursue excessive great peace. the wise man is heeded.

sentences.zh: 八奏《芳醴之曲》：夏王厭芳醴，商湯遠色聲。

translations.literal: Eighth piece, "Melody of Fragrant Wine": the Xia king loathed fragrant wine; Shang Tang kept distant from color and sound.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth piece, "Melody of Fragrant Wine": "The Xia king loathed fragrant wine; Shang Tang kept distant from color and sound."

sentences.zh: 聖人示深戒，千春垂令名。

translations.literal: The sage shows deep warning; a thousand springs hand down the command-name.
translations.idiomatic: The sage shows deep warning. a thousand springs hand down the command-name.

sentences.zh: 惟皇登九五，玉食保尊榮。

translations.literal: Only the emperor ascends nine-five; jade food preserves honored glory.
translations.idiomatic: Only the emperor ascends nine-five. jade food preserves honored glory.

sentences.zh: 日昃不遑餐，佈德延羣生。

translations.literal: The sun slants but he has no leisure to eat; spreading virtue extending to the multitude of living beings.
translations.idiomatic: The sun slants but he has no leisure to eat. spreading virtue extending to the multitude of living beings.

sentences.zh: 天庖具豐膳，鼎鼐事調烹，豈但資肥甘，亦足養遐齡。

translations.literal: Heaven's kitchen prepares rich feasts; tripods and cauldrons attend to blending and cooking; not only supplying rich sweetness; also sufficient to nurture distant age.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's kitchen prepares rich feasts; tripods and cauldrons attend to blending and cooking

sentences.zh: 達人悟茲理，恆令五氣平。

translations.literal: The accomplished man comprehends this principle; always making the five qi level.
translations.idiomatic: The accomplished man comprehends this principle. always making the five qi level.

sentences.zh: 隨時知有節，昭哉天道行。

translations.literal: Following seasons, knowing there are limits; bright is heaven's way proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: Following seasons, knowing there are limits. bright is heaven's way proceeding.

sentences.zh: 九奏《駕六龍之曲》：日麗中天漏下遲，公卿侍宴多令儀。

translations.literal: Ninth piece, "Melody of Driving Six Dragons": sun beautiful at mid-heaven, clepsydra dripping slow; dukes and ministers attending the banquet in many fine observances.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth piece, "Melody of Driving Six Dragons": "Sun beautiful at mid-heaven, clepsydra dripping slow; dukes and ministers attending the banquet in many fine observances."

sentences.zh: 簫韶九奏觴九獻，爐煙細逐祥風吹。

translations.literal: Xiao and shao nine performances, toasts nine offerings; censer smoke finely following auspicious wind blowing.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao and shao nine performances, toasts nine offerings. censer smoke finely following auspicious wind blowing.

sentences.zh: 羣臣舞蹈天顏喜，歲熟民康常若此。

translations.literal: The multitude of ministers dancing; the heavenly countenance pleased; years ripe, people at ease — always like this.
translations.idiomatic: The multitude of ministers dancing; the heavenly countenance pleased

sentences.zh: 六龍回駕鳳樓深，寶扇齊開扶玉幾。

translations.literal: Six dragons turn the carriage; phoenix tower deep; precious fans together open, supporting the jade armrest.
translations.idiomatic: Six dragons turn the carriage; phoenix tower deep

sentences.zh: 景星呈瑞慶雲多，兩曜增暉四序和。

translations.literal: Auspicious stars present omens; celebratory clouds many; the two luminaries increase radiance; the four seasons harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious stars present omens; celebratory clouds many

sentences.zh: 聖人道大如天地，歲歲年年奈樂何。

translations.literal: The sage's way great as heaven and earth; year after year, year after year — how can joy be exhausted?
translations.idiomatic: The sage's way great as heaven and earth. year after year, year after year — how can joy be exhausted?

sentences.zh: 進膳曲，《水龍吟》：寶殿祥雲紫氣濛，聖明君，龍德宮。

translations.literal: Banquet-entering melody, "Water Dragon Chant": precious hall auspicious clouds, purple qi misty; sage bright lord; dragon virtue palace.
translations.idiomatic: Banquet-entering melody, "Water Dragon Chant": "Precious hall auspicious clouds, purple qi misty; sage bright lord; dragon virtue palace."

sentences.zh: 氤氳霧靄，檜柏間青松。

translations.literal: Dense mist and haze; cypress and pine between green pines.
translations.idiomatic: Dense mist and haze. cypress and pine between green pines.

sentences.zh: 龍樓鳳閣，雕梁畫棟，此是蓬萊洞。

translations.literal: Dragon tower, phoenix pavilion; carved beams, painted rafters; this is the Penglai grotto.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon tower, phoenix pavilion; carved beams, painted rafters

sentences.zh: 太平清樂曲，《太清歌》：萬國來朝進貢，仰賀聖明主，一統華夷。

translations.literal: Great Peace Pure Music, "Great Clarity Song": ten thousand states come to court presenting tribute; looking up to congratulate the sage bright lord; one rule of Chinese and barbarian.
translations.idiomatic: Great Peace Pure Music, "Great Clarity Song": "Ten thousand states come to court presenting tribute; looking up to congratulate the sage bright lord; one rule of Chinese and barbarian."

sentences.zh: 普天下八方四海，南北東西。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm the eight directions and four seas; north, south, east, west.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the realm the eight directions and four seas. north, south, east, west.

sentences.zh: 託聖德，勝堯王，保護家國太平，天下都歸一，將兵器銷爲農器。

translations.literal: Relying on sage virtue; surpassing Yao the king; protecting family and state in great peace; all under heaven return to one; turning weapons into farming tools.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on sage virtue; surpassing Yao the king

sentences.zh: 旌旗不動酒旗招，仰荷天地。

translations.literal: Banners and flags unmoved; wine-shop flags beckon; looking up to bear heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Banners and flags unmoved; wine-shop flags beckon

sentences.zh: 《上清歌》：一願四時風調雨順民心喜。

translations.literal: "Upper Clarity Song": one wish — four seasons wind harmonious and rain timely, people's hearts rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: "Upper Clarity Song": one wish — four seasons wind harmonious and rain timely, people's hearts rejoice.

sentences.zh: 攝外國，將寶貝；

translations.literal: Receiving foreign states, bringing treasures;
translations.idiomatic: Receiving foreign states, bringing treasures;

sentences.zh: 攝外國，將寶貝；

translations.literal: Receiving foreign states, bringing treasures;
translations.idiomatic: Receiving foreign states, bringing treasures;

sentences.zh: 見君王，來朝寶殿裏，珊瑚、瑪瑙、玻璃，進在丹墀。

translations.literal: Seeing the sovereign lord, coming to the precious hall; coral, agate, glass — presented on the cinnabar steps.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the sovereign lord, coming to the precious hall. coral, agate, glass — presented on the cinnabar steps.

sentences.zh: 《開天門》：託長生，日月光天德，萬萬歲永固皇基。

translations.literal: "Opening Heaven's Gate": relying on long life; sun and moon light heaven's virtue; ten thousand myriad years forever securing the imperial foundation.
translations.idiomatic: "Opening Heaven's Gate": relying on long life; sun and moon light heaven's virtue

sentences.zh: 公卿文武來朝會，開玳筵，捧金盃。

translations.literal: Dukes, ministers, civil and military come to court assembly; opening tortoise-shell banquet; holding golden cups.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes, ministers, civil and military come to court assembly; opening tortoise-shell banquet

sentences.zh: 迎膳，奏《水龍吟曲》，與進膳同。

translations.literal: Welcoming the banquet, performed "Water Dragon Chant"; same as entering the banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the banquet, performed "Water Dragon Chant". same as entering the banquet.

sentences.zh: 升座、還宮、百官行禮，奏《萬歲樂》、《朝天子》二曲，與朝賀同。

translations.literal: Ascending the seat, returning to the palace, hundred officials performing obeisance — performed "Ten Thousand Years Joy" and "Facing Heaven" two pieces; same as court congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the seat, returning to the palace, hundred officials performing obeisance — performed "Ten Thousand Years Joy" and "Facing Heaven" two pieces. same as court congratulation.

sentences.zh: 大祀慶成大宴，用《萬國來朝隊舞》、《纓鞭得勝隊舞》。

translations.literal: Great sacrifice completion celebration great banquet — used "Ten Thousand States Come to Court Formation Dance" and "Tassel Whip Victorious Formation Dance."
translations.idiomatic: Great sacrifice completion celebration great banquet — used "Ten Thousand States Come to Court Formation Dance" and "Tassel Whip Victorious Formation Dance."

sentences.zh: 萬壽聖節大宴，用《九夷進寶隊舞》、《壽星隊舞》。

translations.literal: Longevity Holy Festival great banquet — used "Nine Yi Present Treasure Formation Dance" and "Longevity Star Formation Dance."
translations.idiomatic: Longevity Holy Festival great banquet — used "Nine Yi Present Treasure Formation Dance" and "Longevity Star Formation Dance."

sentences.zh: 冬至大宴，用《贊聖喜隊舞》、《百花聖朝隊舞》。

translations.literal: Winter solstice great banquet — used "Praising the Sage's Joy Formation Dance" and "Hundred Flowers Holy Court Formation Dance."
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice great banquet — used "Praising the Sage's Joy Formation Dance" and "Hundred Flowers Holy Court Formation Dance."

sentences.zh: 正旦大宴，用《百戲蓮花盆隊舞》、《勝鼓採蓮隊舞》。

translations.literal: New Year's Day great banquet — used "Hundred Plays Lotus Basin Formation Dance" and "Victory Drum Picking Lotus Formation Dance."
translations.idiomatic: New Year's Day great banquet — used "Hundred Plays Lotus Basin Formation Dance" and "Victory Drum Picking Lotus Formation Dance."

sentences.zh: 永樂十八年定宴饗樂舞。

translations.literal: In Yongle year 18 banquet and feast music and dance were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Yongle banquet and feast music and dance were established.

sentences.zh: 一奏《上萬壽之曲》：龍飛定萬方，受天命，振紀綱。

translations.literal: First piece, "Melody of Ascending Ten Thousand Years": dragon flies, settling the ten thousand regions; receiving heaven's mandate; stirring regulations and guidelines.
translations.idiomatic: First piece, "Melody of Ascending Ten Thousand Years": "Dragon flies, settling the ten thousand regions; receiving heaven's mandate; stirring regulations and guidelines."

sentences.zh: 彝倫攸敘四海康，普天率土盡來王。

translations.literal: Constant norms thereby ordered; the four seas at peace; all under heaven and within the seas all come as kings.
translations.idiomatic: Constant norms thereby ordered; the four seas at peace

sentences.zh: 臣民舞蹈，嵩呼載揚，稱觴奉吾皇，聖壽天長。

translations.literal: Subjects and people dancing; Song mountain calls raised and spread; raising cups serving our emperor; sage longevity heaven-long.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects and people dancing; song mountain calls raised and spread

sentences.zh: 《平定天下舞曲》，其一，《四邊靜》：威伏千邦，四夷來賓納表章。

translations.literal: "Dance of Pacifying the Realm," first, "Four Borders Tranquil": awe subdues a thousand states; the four Yi come as guests presenting memorials.
translations.idiomatic: "Dance of Pacifying the Realm," first, "Four Borders Tranquil": "Awe subdues a thousand states; the four Yi come as guests presenting memorials."

sentences.zh: 顯禎祥，承乾象，皇基永昌，萬載山河壯。

translations.literal: Manifesting auspicious omens; receiving the qian image; the imperial foundation forever flourishing; ten thousand ages mountains and rivers majestic.
translations.idiomatic: Manifesting auspicious omens; receiving the qian image

sentences.zh: 其二，《刮地風》：聖主過堯、舜、禹、湯，立五常三綱。

translations.literal: Second, "Scraping the Ground Wind": the sage lord surpasses Yao, Shun, Yu, and Tang; establishing the five constants and three guidelines.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Scraping the Ground Wind": "The sage lord surpasses Yao, Shun, Yu, and Tang; establishing the five constants and three guidelines."

sentences.zh: 八蠻進貢朝今上，頓首誠惶。

translations.literal: The eight barbarians present tribute attending the present sovereign; bowing the head in sincere awe.
translations.idiomatic: The eight barbarians present tribute attending the present sovereign. bowing the head in sincere awe.

sentences.zh: 朝中宰相，變理陰陽。

translations.literal: Court middle chief ministers; transforming and regulating yin and yang.
translations.idiomatic: Court middle chief ministers. transforming and regulating yin and yang.

sentences.zh: 五穀收成，萬民歡暢。

translations.literal: The five grains harvest complete; ten thousand people rejoice and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: The five grains harvest complete. ten thousand people rejoice and at ease.

sentences.zh: 賀吾皇，齊讚揚，萬國來降。

translations.literal: Congratulating our emperor; together praising and raising; ten thousand states come to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Congratulating our emperor; together praising and raising

sentences.zh: 二奏《仰天恩之曲》：皇天眷聖明，五辰順，四海寧，風調雨順百穀登，臣民鼓舞樂太平。

translations.literal: Second piece, "Melody of Looking Up to Heaven's Grace": bright heaven cherishes sage brilliance; the five chronograms orderly; the four seas tranquil; wind harmonious rain timely, hundred grains rise; subjects and people drum and dance, rejoice in great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Second piece, "Melody of Looking Up to Heaven's Grace": "Bright heaven cherishes sage brilliance; the five chronograms orderly; the four seas tranquil; wind harmonious rain timely, hundred grains rise; subjects and people drum and dance, rejoice in great peace."

sentences.zh: 賢良在位，邦家永禎。

translations.literal: Worthy and good in position; the state family forever auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Worthy and good in position. the state family forever auspicious.

sentences.zh: 吾皇仰洪恩，夙夜存誠。

translations.literal: Our emperor looks up to great grace; early and late preserving sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Our emperor looks up to great grace. early and late preserving sincerity.

sentences.zh: 黃童白叟鼓腹謳歌承應曲，曰《豆葉黃》：雨順風調，五穀收成，倉廩豐盈，大利民生。

translations.literal: Yellow lads and white elders drumming the belly singing responsive melody, titled "Bean Leaf Yellow": rain favorable, wind harmonious; five grains harvest complete; granaries full and overflowing; great benefit to the people's livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow lads and white elders drumming the belly singing responsive melody, titled "Bean Leaf Yellow": "Rain favorable, wind harmonious; five grains harvest complete; granaries full and overflowing; great benefit to the people's livelihood."

sentences.zh: 托賴著皇恩四海清，鼓腹謳歌，白叟黃童，共樂咸寧。

translations.literal: Relying on the emperor's grace the four seas clear; drumming the belly singing praise; white elders, yellow lads; together rejoicing in universal peace.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the emperor's grace the four seas clear; drumming the belly singing praise

sentences.zh: 四夷舞曲，其一，《小將軍》：順天心，聖德誠，化番邦，盡朝京。

translations.literal: Four Yi dance music, first, "Little General": following heaven's heart; sage virtue sincere; transforming frontier states; all attend the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Four Yi dance music, first, "Little General": "Following heaven's heart; sage virtue sincere; transforming frontier states; all attend the capital."

sentences.zh: 四夷歸伏，舞於龍廷。

translations.literal: The four Yi submit; dancing at the dragon court.
translations.idiomatic: The four Yi submit. dancing at the dragon court.

sentences.zh: 貢皇明，寶貝擎。

translations.literal: Presenting tribute to brilliant Ming; treasures raised high.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting tribute to brilliant Ming. treasures raised high.

sentences.zh: 其二，《殿前歡》：四夷率土歸王命，都來仰大明。

translations.literal: Second, "Hall Delight": the four Yi leading soil return to the king's command; all come looking up to great Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Hall Delight": "The four Yi leading soil return to the king's command; all come looking up to great Ming."

sentences.zh: 萬邦千國皆歸正，現帝庭，朝仁聖。

translations.literal: Ten thousand states, thousand countries all return to orthodoxy; appearing at the imperial court; attending the benevolent sage.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand states, thousand countries all return to orthodoxy; appearing at the imperial court

sentences.zh: 天階班列衆公卿，齊聲歌太平。

translations.literal: Heaven's steps ranks array the multitude of dukes and ministers; together singing great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's steps ranks array the multitude of dukes and ministers. together singing great peace.

sentences.zh: 其三，《慶豐年》：和氣增，鸞鳳鳴，紫霧生，祥雲朝霞映。

translations.literal: Third, "Celebrating Abundant Harvest": harmonious qi increases; luan and phoenix cry; purple mist arises; auspicious clouds and dawn radiance reflect.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "Celebrating Abundant Harvest": "Harmonious qi increases; luan and phoenix cry; purple mist arises; auspicious clouds and dawn radiance reflect."

sentences.zh: 爇金爐，香味馨，列丹墀，御駕盈。

translations.literal: Lighting the golden censer; fragrance scent fresh; arrayed on cinnabar steps; imperial carriage full.
translations.idiomatic: Lighting the golden censer; fragrance scent fresh

sentences.zh: 弦管簫韶五音應，龍笛間鳳笙。

translations.literal: Strings, pipes, xiao and shao — five tones respond; dragon flute between phoenix sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Strings, pipes, xiao and shao — five tones respond. dragon flute between phoenix sheng.

sentences.zh: 其四，《渤海令》：金盃中，酒滿盛。

translations.literal: Fourth, "Bohai Command": in the golden cup; wine full and brimming.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, "Bohai Command": "In the golden cup; wine full and brimming."

sentences.zh: 御案前，列羣英。

translations.literal: Before the imperial table; arrayed outstanding heroes.
translations.idiomatic: Before the imperial table. arrayed outstanding heroes.

sentences.zh: 君德成，皇圖慶，嵩呼萬歲聲。

translations.literal: Sovereign virtue accomplished; imperial design celebrated; Song mountain calls of ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Sovereign virtue accomplished; imperial design celebrated
