sentences.zh: 其五，《過門子》：聖主興，聖主興，顯威靈，蠻夷靜。

translations.literal: Fifth, "Passing the Gate": the sage lord rises, the sage lord rises; manifesting awe-inspiring spirit; barbarians tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, "Passing the Gate": "The sage lord rises, the sage lord rises; manifesting awe-inspiring spirit; barbarians tranquil."

sentences.zh: 至仁至德至聖明，萬萬年，帝業成。

translations.literal: Utmost benevolence, utmost virtue, utmost sage brilliance; ten thousand myriad years; the imperial enterprise accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Utmost benevolence, utmost virtue, utmost sage brilliance; ten thousand myriad years

sentences.zh: 三奏《感地德之曲》：皇心感地靈，順天時，德厚生。

translations.literal: Third piece, "Melody of Feeling Earth's Virtue": the imperial heart feels earth's spirit; following heaven's seasons; virtue thick, life abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Third piece, "Melody of Feeling Earth's Virtue": "The imperial heart feels earth's spirit; following heaven's seasons; virtue thick, life abundant."

sentences.zh: 含弘光大品物亨，鍾奇毓秀產俊英。

translations.literal: Inclusive, vast, bright and great — all things prosperous; concentrating wonders, nurturing excellence, producing outstanding heroes.
translations.idiomatic: Inclusive, vast, bright and great — all things prosperous. concentrating wonders, nurturing excellence, producing outstanding heroes.

sentences.zh: 河清海宴，麟來鳳鳴，陰陽永和平，相我文明。

translations.literal: River clear, sea calm; qilin comes, phoenix cries; yin and yang forever harmonious; assisting our civil splendor.
translations.idiomatic: River clear, sea calm; qilin comes, phoenix cries

sentences.zh: 《車書會同舞曲》，其一，《新水令》：錦衣花帽設丹墀，具公服百司同會。

translations.literal: "Dance of Chariots and Writing United," first, "New Water Order": brocade robes and flowered caps set on cinnabar steps; fully robed, the hundred offices together assemble.
translations.idiomatic: "Dance of Chariots and Writing United," first, "New Water Order": "Brocade robes and flowered caps set on cinnabar steps; fully robed, the hundred offices together assemble."

sentences.zh: 麟至舞，鳳來儀，文武班齊，朝賀聖明帝。

translations.literal: Qilin arrives dancing; phoenix comes with ceremony; civil and military ranks together; congratulating the sage bright emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Qilin arrives dancing; phoenix comes with ceremony

sentences.zh: 其二，《水仙子》：八方四面錦華夷，天下蒼生仰聖德。

translations.literal: Second, "Water Immortal": eight directions, four faces — brocade Chinese and Yi; all under heaven's common people look up to sage virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Water Immortal": "Eight directions, four faces — brocade Chinese and Yi; all under heaven's common people look up to sage virtue."

sentences.zh: 風調雨順昇平世，遍乾坤，皆贊禮，託君恩民樂雍熙。

translations.literal: Wind harmonious, rain timely, ascending peace age; throughout heaven and earth; all praise rites; relying on the lord's grace, people rejoice in flourishing harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Wind harmonious, rain timely, ascending peace age; throughout heaven and earth

sentences.zh: 萬萬年皇基堅固，萬萬載江山定體，萬萬歲洪福天齊。

translations.literal: Ten thousand myriad years the imperial foundation firm; ten thousand myriad ages rivers and mountains fixed in form; ten thousand years great blessing equal to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand myriad years the imperial foundation firm; ten thousand myriad ages rivers and mountains fixed in form

sentences.zh: 四奏《民樂生之曲》：世間的萬民，荷天地，感聖恩。

translations.literal: Fourth piece, "Melody of the People's Joy in Life": the ten thousand people of the world; bearing heaven and earth; feeling sage grace.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth piece, "Melody of the People's Joy in Life": "The ten thousand people of the world; bearing heaven and earth; feeling sage grace."

sentences.zh: 乾坤定位四海春，君臣父子正大倫。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth positioned, the four seas spring; ruler and minister, father and son — the great norms upright.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth positioned, the four seas spring. ruler and minister, father and son — the great norms upright.

sentences.zh: 皇風浩蕩，人心載醇，熙熙樂天真，永戴明君。

translations.literal: Imperial wind vast and sweeping; people's hearts bearing pure wine; prosperous, rejoicing in heaven's truth; forever wearing the bright lord.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial wind vast and sweeping; people's hearts bearing pure wine

sentences.zh: 《表正萬邦舞曲》，其一，《慶太平》：奸邪濁亂朝綱，構禍難，煽動戈ＡＵ。

translations.literal: "Dance of Displaying Orthodoxy for Ten Thousand States," first, "Celebrating Great Peace": treacherous and evil, turbid and disordering the court guidelines; constructing calamity and difficulty; stirring spears and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: "Dance of Displaying Orthodoxy for Ten Thousand States," first, "Celebrating Great Peace": "Treacherous and evil, turbid and disordering the court guidelines; constructing calamity and difficulty; stirring spears and weapons."

sentences.zh: 赫怒吾皇，親征灞上，指天戈，敵皆降。

translations.literal: Majestically enraged, our emperor personally campaigned at Bashang; pointing the heavenly halberd; enemies all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Majestically enraged, our emperor personally campaigned at Bashang; pointing the heavenly halberd

sentences.zh: 其二，《武士歡》：白溝戰場，旌旗雲合迷日光。

translations.literal: Second, "Warrior's Joy": at Baigou battlefield; banners and flags cloud-massed, dimming the sun's light.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Warrior's Joy": "At Baigou battlefield; banners and flags cloud-massed, dimming the sun's light."

sentences.zh: 令嚴氣張，三軍踊躍齊奮揚，掃除殘甲如風蕩，凱歌傳四方。

translations.literal: Orders strict, qi expansive; the three armies leaping together striving and raising; sweeping remnant armor like wind scattering; victory songs spread the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Orders strict, qi expansive; the three armies leaping together striving and raising

sentences.zh: 仁聖不殺降，望河南，失欃槍。

translations.literal: Benevolent and sage — not killing those who submit; gazing toward Henan; the comet lost.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent and sage — not killing those who submit; gazing toward Henan; the comet lost.

sentences.zh: 其三，《滾繡球》：肆旅拒，恃力強，一心構殃，築滄洲百尺城隍。

translations.literal: Third, "Rolling Embroidered Ball": the Di travelers resisted; relying on strength; one heart constructing calamity; building on Cangzhou hundred-foot walls and moats.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "Rolling Embroidered Ball": "The Di travelers resisted; relying on strength; one heart constructing calamity; building on Cangzhou hundred-foot walls and moats."

sentences.zh: 騁蠆毒，恣虎狼，孰能御當。

translations.literal: Unleashing scorpion poison; indulging tigers and wolves; who could oppose and withstand?
translations.idiomatic: Unleashing scorpion poison; indulging tigers and wolves

sentences.zh: 順天心有德隆昌，倒戈斂甲齊歸降，撫將生還達故鄉，自此仁聞愈彰。

translations.literal: Following heaven's heart, virtue grand and flourishing; turning spears, gathering armor, together returning to submit; soothing generals, sending them living back to reach their homeland; from this benevolence heard ever more manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Following heaven's heart, virtue grand and flourishing; turning spears, gathering armor, together returning to submit

sentences.zh: 其四，《陣陣贏》：不數孫吳兵法良，神謀睿算合陰陽，八陣堂堂行天上，虎略龍韜孰敢當。

translations.literal: Fourth, "Formation after Formation Victorious": not counting Sun and Wu's military methods as good; divine plans and wise calculations joining yin and yang; eight formations grand and grand marching in heaven; tiger strategies and dragon plans — who dares withstand?
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, "Formation after Formation Victorious": "Not counting Sun and Wu's military methods as good; divine plans and wise calculations joining yin and yang; eight formations grand and grand marching in heaven; tiger strategies and dragon plans — who dares withstand?"

sentences.zh: 俘囚十萬皆疏放，感荷仁恩戴上蒼。

translations.literal: Captives and prisoners a hundred thousand all released and sent forth; feeling and bearing benevolent grace, wearing it on high heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Captives and prisoners a hundred thousand all released and sent forth. feeling and bearing benevolent grace, wearing it on high heaven.

sentences.zh: 其五，《得勝回》：兩傍四方，展鳥翼風雲雁行。

translations.literal: Fifth, "Victory Return": two flanks, four directions; spreading bird wings, wind and clouds, wild-goose ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, "Victory Return": "Two flanks, four directions; spreading bird wings, wind and clouds, wild-goose ranks."

sentences.zh: 出奇兵，敵難量，士強馬強。

translations.literal: Deploying strange troops; enemies hard to measure; soldiers strong, horses strong.
translations.idiomatic: Deploying strange troops; enemies hard to measure

sentences.zh: 遍百里，眠旌臥槍。

translations.literal: Throughout a hundred li; sleeping banners, resting spears.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout a hundred li. sleeping banners, resting spears.

sentences.zh: 勝兵回，樂洋洋。

translations.literal: Victorious troops return; joy vast and wide.
translations.idiomatic: Victorious troops return. joy vast and wide.

sentences.zh: 其六，《小梁州》：敵兵戰敗神魂喪，擁貔貅，直渡長江。

translations.literal: Sixth, "Little Liangzhou": enemy troops defeated, spirits lost; embracing brave warriors, straight crossing the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, "Little Liangzhou": the foe is routed and their spirit broken; with bold warriors he crosses the Yangtze straightway.

sentences.zh: 開市門，肆不移，宣聖恩，如天曠。

translations.literal: Opening market gates, shops unmoved; proclaiming sage grace, like heaven vast.
translations.idiomatic: The markets open, the shops stay put; sage grace is proclaimed wide as the open sky.

sentences.zh: 綸音頒降，普天下，仰吾皇。

translations.literal: Imperial pronouncements descend; all under heaven look up to our emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial edicts go forth; all under heaven look up to our emperor.

sentences.zh: 五奏《感皇恩之曲》：當今四海寧，頌聲作，禮樂興。

translations.literal: Fifth piece, "Melody of Feeling Imperial Grace": now the four seas tranquil; praise-sound arises; ritual and music flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth piece, "Melody of Feeling Imperial Grace": the four seas are tranquil now; praise rises; ritual and music flourish anew.

sentences.zh: 君臣慶會躋太平，衣冠濟濟宴彤庭。

translations.literal: Ruler and ministers celebrate meeting, ascending great peace; robes and caps numerous feast in the red court.
translations.idiomatic: Ruler and ministers rejoice together in great peace; in robes and caps they feast in the red court.

sentences.zh: 文臣武將，共荷恩榮，忠心盡微誠，仰答皇明。

translations.literal: Civil ministers and martial generals together bear grace and glory; loyal hearts exhaust slight sincerity; looking up to answer brilliant Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and martial officials alike bear grace and glory; with loyal hearts they answer brilliant Ming.

sentences.zh: 《天命有德舞曲》，其一，《慶宣和》：雨順風調萬物熙，一統華夷。

translations.literal: "Mandate of Heaven Has Virtue Dance," first, "Celebrating Xuanhe": rain favorable, wind harmonious, ten thousand things prosperous; one rule of Chinese and barbarian.
translations.idiomatic: "Mandate of Heaven Has Virtue Dance," first, "Celebrating Xuanhe": with favorable rain and wind all things thrive; Chinese and barbarian are one.

sentences.zh: 四野嘉禾感和氣，一干百穗，一干百穗。

translations.literal: In the four wilds fine grain feels harmonious qi; one stalk, hundred ears; one stalk, hundred ears.
translations.idiomatic: In every field the grain feels harmonious qi; stalk upon stalk bears a hundred ears.

sentences.zh: 其二，《窄磚兒》：梯航萬國來丹陛，太平年，永固洪基。

translations.literal: Second, "Narrow Brick": ladder ships, ten thousand states come to the cinnabar steps; great peace year; forever securing the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Narrow Brick": ladder-ships from ten thousand lands reach the cinnabar steps; in this age of peace the foundation stands forever.

sentences.zh: 正東西南北來朝會，洽寰宇，布春暉，四夷咸賓聲教美。

translations.literal: Just then east, west, south, north come to court assembly; harmonizing the universe; spreading spring radiance; the four Yi all guests, sound of teaching beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: From east, west, south, and north they come to court; the realm is harmonized, spring light spread abroad; the four Yi are guests, and the teaching's sound is fair.

sentences.zh: 自古明王在慎德，不須威武服戎狄。

translations.literal: Since antiquity bright kings are careful in virtue; not needing martial awe to subdue Rong and Di.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity the bright king has been careful in virtue and need not rely on arms to tame the Rong and Di.

sentences.zh: 祥瑞集，鳳來儀。

translations.literal: Auspicious omens gather; phoenix comes with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious omens gather; the phoenix comes in ceremony.

sentences.zh: 佳期萬萬歲，聖明君，主華夷。

translations.literal: Fine period ten thousand myriad years; sage bright lord; master of Chinese and barbarian.
translations.idiomatic: May this fine age last ten thousand myriad years; the sage bright lord rules Chinese and barbarian alike.

sentences.zh: 六奏《慶豐年之曲》：萬方仰聖君，大一統，撫萬民。

translations.literal: Sixth piece, "Melody of Celebrating Abundant Harvest": the ten thousand regions look up to the sage lord; great unity; soothing ten thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth piece, "Melody of Celebrating Abundant Harvest": the ten thousand regions look up to the sage lord; in great unity he soothes the people.

sentences.zh: 豐年時序雨露均，穰穰五穀貨財殷。

translations.literal: Abundant harvest seasons, rain and dew even; abundant abundant five grains, goods and wealth rich.
translations.idiomatic: In seasons of plenty rain and dew are even; grain piles high and goods and wealth abound.

sentences.zh: 酣歌擊壤，風清俗淳，四夷悉來賓，正統皇仁。

translations.literal: Drunken songs, beating clods; wind clear, customs pure; the four Yi all come as guests; orthodox imperial benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: They sing drunk and beat the clods; wind is clear, customs pure; the four Yi all come as guests under orthodox imperial benevolence.

sentences.zh: 七奏《集禎應之曲》：皇天眷大明，五星聚，兆太平；

translations.literal: Seventh piece, "Melody of Gathering Auspicious Responses": bright heaven cherishes Great Ming; five stars gather; omen of great peace;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh piece, "Melody of Gathering Auspicious Responses": bright heaven cherishes Great Ming; the five stars gather — an omen of great peace;

sentences.zh: 騶虞出現甘露零，野蠶成繭嘉禾生，醴泉涌地河水清。

translations.literal: Zouyu appears, sweet dew descends; wild silkworms form cocoons, fine grain grows; sweet spring wells from earth, river water clear.
translations.idiomatic: Zouyu appears, sweet dew falls; wild silkworms spin cocoons, fine grain springs up; sweet springs well from the earth and the rivers run clear.

sentences.zh: 乾坤萬萬年，四海永寧。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth ten thousand myriad years; the four seas forever tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: May heaven and earth endure ten thousand myriad years; may the four seas know peace forever.

sentences.zh: 八奏《永皇圖之曲》：天心眷聖皇，正天位，撫萬邦。

translations.literal: Eighth piece, "Melody of Forever Securing the Imperial Design": heaven's heart cherishes the sage emperor; rectifying heaven's position; soothing ten thousand states.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth piece, "Melody of Forever Securing the Imperial Design": heaven's heart cherishes the sage emperor; he rectifies heaven's throne and soothes ten thousand states.

sentences.zh: 仁風宣佈禮樂張，戎夷稽首朝明堂。

translations.literal: Benevolent wind proclaimed, ritual and music spread; Rong and Yi bow the head at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent wind is proclaimed abroad; ritual and music spread wide; Rong and Yi bow at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 皇圖鞏固，賢臣贊襄。

translations.literal: Imperial design firm and solid; worthy ministers assist and support.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial design stands firm; worthy ministers assist and uphold it.

sentences.zh: 太平日月光，地久天長。

translations.literal: Great peace, sun and moon bright; earth long-lasting, heaven long-lasting.
translations.idiomatic: Great peace shines like sun and moon; may earth and heaven long endure.

sentences.zh: 九奏《樂太平之曲》：皇恩被八紘，三光明，四海清。

translations.literal: Ninth piece, "Melody of Rejoicing in Great Peace": imperial grace covers the eight cords; three luminaries bright; the four seas clear.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth piece, "Melody of Rejoicing in Great Peace": imperial grace covers the eight cords; the three luminaries shine; the four seas are clear.

sentences.zh: 人康物阜歲屢登，含哺鼓腹皆歡聲。

translations.literal: People at ease, things abundant, years repeatedly abundant harvest; holding in the mouth, drumming the belly — all sounds of rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: People are at ease, things abound, harvest follows harvest; nursing at the breast and drumming the belly, all raise sounds of joy.

sentences.zh: 民歌帝力，唐堯至仁。

translations.literal: The people sing the emperor's strength; Yao of Tang utmost benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: The people sing the emperor's strength — the utmost benevolence of Yao of Tang.

sentences.zh: 乾坤永清，共樂太平。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth forever clear; together rejoicing in great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth forever clear; together they rejoice in great peace.

sentences.zh: 導膳、迎膳、進膳及升座、還宮、百官行禮諸曲，俱與洪武間同。

translations.literal: Guiding the banquet, welcoming the banquet, entering the banquet, and ascending the seat, returning to the palace, hundred officials performing obeisance — all pieces same as Hongwu period.
translations.idiomatic: For guiding the banquet, welcoming the banquet, entering the banquet, ascending the seat, returning to the palace, and officials' obeisance — all pieces are as in the Hongwu period.

sentences.zh: 大祀慶成，用《纓鞭得勝蠻夷隊舞》；

translations.literal: Great sacrifice completion celebration — used "Tassel Whip Victorious Barbarian Formation Dance";
translations.idiomatic: For the great sacrifice completion celebration — "Tassel Whip Victorious Barbarian Formation Dance" was used;

sentences.zh: 萬壽聖節，《九夷進寶隊舞》；

translations.literal: Longevity Holy Festival — "Nine Yi Present Treasure Formation Dance";
translations.idiomatic: For the Longevity Holy Festival — "Nine Yi Present Treasure Formation Dance";

sentences.zh: 冬至節，《贊聖喜隊舞》；

translations.literal: Winter solstice festival — "Praising the Sage's Joy Formation Dance";
translations.idiomatic: For the winter solstice — "Praising the Sage's Joy Formation Dance";

sentences.zh: 正旦節，《百戲蓮盆隊舞》。

translations.literal: New Year's Day festival — "Hundred Plays Lotus Basin Formation Dance".
translations.idiomatic: For New Year's Day — "Hundred Plays Lotus Basin Formation Dance."

sentences.zh: ○嘉靖間續定慶成宴樂章

translations.literal: ○ During the Jiajing reign, banquet music for completion celebrations was additionally established.
translations.idiomatic: ○ During the Jiajing reign, music for completion-celebration banquets was additionally established.

sentences.zh: 升座，樂曲《萬歲樂》：五百昌期嘉慶會，啓聖皇，龍飛天位。

translations.literal: Ascending the seat, music "Ten Thousand Years Joy": five hundred flourishing periods, auspicious celebration meeting; opening the sage emperor; dragon flies to heaven's position.
translations.idiomatic: On ascending the seat, "Ten Thousand Years Joy": five hundred flourishing periods meet in celebration; the sage emperor opens his reign; the dragon ascends to heaven's throne.

sentences.zh: 九州四海重華日，大明朝，萬萬世。

translations.literal: The nine regions, four seas — again a day of double splendor; Great Ming dynasty, ten thousand myriad generations.
translations.idiomatic: The nine regions and four seas again know a day of double splendor; the Great Ming shall stand ten thousand myriad generations.

sentences.zh: 百官行禮，樂曲《朝天子》：滿前瑞煙，香繞蓬萊殿，風回韶律鼓淵淵，列陛上，旌旗絢，日至硃躔。

translations.literal: Hundred officials performing obeisance, music "Facing Heaven": filling the front, auspicious smoke; fragrance coiling around Penglai Hall; wind returning, shao rhythm drums deep and deep; arrayed on the steps; banners and flags brilliant; sun reaches vermilion reins.
translations.idiomatic: When officials perform obeisance, "Facing Heaven": auspicious smoke fills the forecourt; fragrance coils round Penglai Hall; returning wind stirs shao drums deep and deep; on the steps banners blaze; the sun reaches the vermilion reins.

sentences.zh: 陽生赤甸氣和融，徹上元。

translations.literal: Yang arises on the red fields; qi harmonious and blended; reaching the first yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang rises over the red fields; qi blends in harmony; the first yuan is attained.

sentences.zh: 歷年萬千，長慶天宮宴。

translations.literal: Years passing thousands; long celebration of heaven palace banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Years pass by the thousand; long may the heaven-palace banquet be celebrated.

sentences.zh: 上護衣、上花，樂曲《水龍吟》：寶殿金爐瑞靄浮，陳玉案，列珍羞。

translations.literal: Upper protective garment, upper flower, music "Water Dragon Chant": precious hall golden censer auspicious mist floating; displaying jade table; arraying rare delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Upper protective garment, upper flower — "Water Dragon Chant": auspicious mist floats from the golden censer; the jade table is set with rare delicacies.

sentences.zh: 天花炫彩，照曜翠雲裘。

translations.literal: Heaven flowers dazzle in color; shining upon emerald cloud robes.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven-flowers dazzle in color, shining on robes of emerald cloud.

sentences.zh: 鸞歌鳳舞，虞庭樂奏，萬歲君王壽。

translations.literal: Luan songs, phoenix dances; Yu court music performed; ten thousand years the sovereign lord's longevity.
translations.idiomatic: Luan song and phoenix dance; Yu-court music plays; ten thousand years to the sovereign's longevity.

sentences.zh: 一奏《上萬歲之曲》：聖主垂衣裳，興禮樂，邁虞唐。

translations.literal: First piece, "Melody of Ascending Ten Thousand Years": the sage lord drapes with upper and lower garments; raising ritual and music; surpassing Yu and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: First piece, "Melody of Ascending Ten Thousand Years": the sage lord drapes himself and raises ritual and music, surpassing Yu and Tang.

sentences.zh: 簫韶九成儀鳳凰，日月中天照八荒。

translations.literal: Xiao and shao nine accomplishments, phoenix ceremony; sun and moon at mid-heaven shine the eight wilds.
translations.idiomatic: With xiao and shao in nine accomplishments the phoenix rite is performed; sun and moon at mid-heaven light the eight wilds.

sentences.zh: 民安物阜，時和歲康。

translations.literal: People settled, things abundant; seasons harmonious, years at ease.
translations.idiomatic: The people are settled, things abundant; seasons are harmonious and years at ease.

sentences.zh: 上奉萬年觴，胤祚無疆。

translations.literal: Above offering the ten thousand years goblet; posterity and fortune without boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Above they raise the ten-thousand-years goblet; may posterity and fortune know no bound.

sentences.zh: 奏《平定天下舞曲》，其一，《四邊靜》：天啓嘉祥，聖主中興振紀綱。

translations.literal: Performed "Dance of Pacifying the Realm," first, "Four Borders Tranquil": heaven opens auspicious omens; sage lord middle revival stirring regulations and guidelines.
translations.idiomatic: "Dance of Pacifying the Realm," first, "Four Borders Tranquil": heaven opens auspicious omens; the sage lord revives the middle kingdom and stirs regulations and guidelines.

sentences.zh: 頌洋洋，功蕩蕩，國運隆昌，萬歲皇圖壯。

translations.literal: Praise vast; achievements expansive; state fortune grand and flourishing; ten thousand years imperial design majestic.
translations.idiomatic: Praise resounds, achievements spread; state fortune flourishes; ten thousand years to the imperial design.

sentences.zh: 其二，《鳳鸞吟》：維皇上天佑聖明，景命宣，五雲輝，三臺潤，七緯光懸。

translations.literal: Second, "Phoenix and Luan Chant": only the emperor above heaven blesses sage brilliance; bright mandate proclaimed; five clouds glorious; three terraces moist; seven regulators' light suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Phoenix and Luan Chant": only the emperor above blesses sage brilliance; the bright mandate is proclaimed; five clouds shine; three terraces are moist; seven regulators' light hangs suspended.

sentences.zh: 協氣生，嘉祥見。

translations.literal: Harmonious qi arises; auspicious omens appear.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious qi arises. auspicious omens appear.

sentences.zh: 正萬民，用羣賢。

translations.literal: Rectifying ten thousand people; employing the multitude of worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He rectifies the ten thousand people and employs the multitude of worthies.

sentences.zh: 垂袞御經筵，宵衣勤政殿。

translations.literal: Draping robes, attending the classics hall; night garments, diligent government hall.
translations.idiomatic: Robes draped, he attends the classics hall; in night garments he is diligent in the government hall.

sentences.zh: 禮圜丘大祀精虔，明水潔，蒼璧圓。

translations.literal: Rites at the circular altar great sacrifice refined and sincere; bright water pure; dark jade disk round.
translations.idiomatic: At the circular altar the great sacrifice is refined and sincere; bright water is pure; the dark jade disk is round.

sentences.zh: 秉周文，承殷薦，眷皇家億萬斯年。

translations.literal: Holding Zhou culture; receiving Yin offerings; cherishing the royal house ten thousand myriad years.
translations.idiomatic: Holding Zhou's culture and receiving Yin's offerings, he cherishes the royal house for ten thousand myriad years.

sentences.zh: 二奏《仰天恩之曲》：皇穹啓聖神，欽乾運，祗郊禋。

translations.literal: Second piece, "Melody of Looking Up to Heaven's Grace": the bright vault opens sage spirit; revering qian fortune; respecting suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Second piece, "Melody of Looking Up to Heaven's Grace": the bright vault opens the sage spirit; he reveres qian's fortune and respects the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 一陽初動靄先春，萬福來同仰至仁。

translations.literal: One yang first moves, mist before spring; ten thousand blessings come together looking up to utmost benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: When one yang first stirs, mist precedes spring; ten thousand blessings come together as men look up to utmost benevolence.

sentences.zh: 祥開日月，瑞見星辰。

translations.literal: Auspiciousness opens sun and moon; omens appear in stars and constellations.
translations.idiomatic: Auspiciousness opens on sun and moon; omens appear among the stars.

sentences.zh: 禮樂協神人，宇宙咸新。

translations.literal: Ritual and music harmonize spirits and men; the universe all new.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual and music bring spirits and men into harmony; the universe is made new.

sentences.zh: 迎膳曲，《水龍吟》：春滿雕盤獻玉桃，葭管動，日輪高。

translations.literal: Welcoming banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": spring fills carved plates presenting jade peaches; reed pipes move; sun wheel high.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming-banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": spring fills carved plates with jade peaches; reed pipes sound; the sun-wheel rides high.

sentences.zh: 熹微霽色，遙映袞龍袍。

translations.literal: Dawn light faint; far reflecting dragon robes.
translations.idiomatic: Faint dawn light far reflects upon the dragon robes.

sentences.zh: 千官舞蹈，鈞韶迭奏，曲度昇平調。

translations.literal: Thousand officials dancing; jun shao played in turn; tune degree ascending peace mode.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand officials dance; jun shao is played in turn to the ascending-peace mode.

sentences.zh: 進膳曲，《水龍吟》：紫禁瓊筵暖應冬，驂八螭，乘六龍，玉卮瓊斝，黼座獻重瞳。

translations.literal: Entering banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": forbidden purple jade banquet warm answering winter; paired eight chi; riding six dragons; jade goblets, jade cups; brocade seat presenting double pupils.
translations.idiomatic: Entering-banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": in the forbidden purple hall the jade feast answers winter; paired eight chi, six dragons; jade goblets and cups; the brocade seat presents his double pupils.

sentences.zh: 堯天廣運，舜雲飛動，喜聽賡歌頌。

translations.literal: Yao heaven broad fortune; Shun clouds fly and move; gladly hearing continuing songs and praise.
translations.idiomatic: Yao's heaven spreads broad fortune; Shun's clouds fly and shift; gladly they hear continuing song and praise.

sentences.zh: 進湯曲，其一，《太清歌》：長至日，開黃道，喜乾坤佳氣，陽長陰消。

translations.literal: Soup-entering melody, first, "Great Clarity Song": solstice day; opening the yellow way; rejoicing in heaven and earth's fine qi; yang long, yin consumed.
translations.idiomatic: Soup melody, first, "Great Clarity Song": on the solstice day the yellow way opens; heaven and earth rejoice in fine qi; yang lengthens and yin is consumed.

sentences.zh: 奏鈞韶，音調鳳軫，律協鸞簫。

translations.literal: Performing jun shao; tone tuning phoenix pegs; pitch harmonizing luan xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Jun shao is performed; tones tune the phoenix pegs; pitch harmonizes the luan xiao.

sentences.zh: 仰龍顏，天日表，如舜如堯。

translations.literal: Looking up at dragon countenance; heaven and sun's appearance; like Shun, like Yao.
translations.idiomatic: They look up at the dragon countenance — heaven and sun's face, like Shun, like Yao.

sentences.zh: 金爐煙暖御香飄，玉墀晴霽祥光繞。

translations.literal: Golden censer smoke warm, imperial fragrance floating; jade steps clear after rain auspicious light coiling.
translations.idiomatic: Golden censer smoke warms; imperial fragrance drifts; on jade steps, cleared by rain, auspicious light coils.

sentences.zh: 宮梅苑柳迎春好，燕樂蓬萊島。

translations.literal: Palace plum, garden willow welcome spring well; yan music Penglai isle.
translations.idiomatic: Palace plum and garden willow welcome spring; yan music on Penglai Isle.

sentences.zh: 其二，《上清歌》：雲捧宸居，五星光映三臺麗。

translations.literal: Second, "Upper Clarity Song": clouds supporting the imperial dwelling; five stars' light reflecting three terraces beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Upper Clarity Song": clouds uphold the imperial dwelling; five stars' light makes the three terraces fair.

sentences.zh: 仰日月，層霄霽；

translations.literal: Looking up at sun and moon; layered skies clear;
translations.idiomatic: They look up at sun and moon; the layered skies are clear.

sentences.zh: 仰日月，層霄霽。

translations.literal: Looking up at sun and moon; layered skies clear;
translations.idiomatic: They look up at sun and moon; the layered skies are clear.

sentences.zh: 中興重見唐虞際，太和元氣自陽回，兆姓歡愉。

translations.literal: Middle revival again sees the Tang-Yu border; great harmony primordial qi from yang returns; the hundred surnames joyous.
translations.idiomatic: The middle revival again meets the age of Tang and Yu; great harmony's primordial qi returns from yang; the hundred surnames rejoice.

sentences.zh: 其三，《開天門》：九重霄，日轉皇州曉。

translations.literal: Third, "Opening Heaven's Gate": ninefold heavens; sun turns, imperial capital dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "Opening Heaven's Gate": on the ninefold heavens the sun turns and the imperial capital dawns.

sentences.zh: 宴天家，共歌《魚藻》。

translations.literal: Banquet heaven's family; together singing "Fish and Water".
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's family feasts; together they sing "Fish and Water."

sentences.zh: 龍鱗雉尾高，祝聖壽，慶清朝。

translations.literal: Dragon scales, pheasant tail high; congratulating sage longevity; celebrating the clear dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon scales and pheasant tail rise high; they wish the sage long life and celebrate the clear dynasty.

sentences.zh: 奏黃童白叟鼓腹謳歌承應曲，《御鑾歌》：雅奏樂昇平，瞻絳闕，集瑤京。

translations.literal: Performed yellow lads and white elders drumming belly singing responsive melody, "Imperial Carriage Song": elegant performance music ascending peace; gazing at crimson gate; gathering jade capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow lads and white elders drum their bellies in the responsive "Imperial Carriage Song": elegant music ascends in peace; they gaze at the crimson gate and gather at the jade capital.

sentences.zh: 黃童白叟喜氣盈，謳歌鼓舞四海寧。

translations.literal: Yellow lads and white elders joyous qi full; songs and drums dancing, the four seas tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow lads and white elders brim with joy; song and drum dance, and the four seas are tranquil.

sentences.zh: 金枝結秀，玉樹含英。

translations.literal: Golden branches form splendor; jade trees hold blooms.
translations.idiomatic: Golden branches show splendor; jade trees hold their bloom.

sentences.zh: 聽康衢擊壤聲，帝力難名。

translations.literal: Hearing Kangshu road beating-clod sound; the emperor's strength hard to name.
translations.idiomatic: They hear on the Kangshu road the sound of beating clods — the emperor's strength is beyond naming.

sentences.zh: 三奏《感昊德之曲》：帝德運光明，一陽動，萬物生。

translations.literal: Third piece, "Melody of Feeling Vast Virtue": emperor virtue moves brightness; one yang moves; ten thousand things live.
translations.idiomatic: Third piece, "Melody of Feeling Vast Virtue": the emperor's virtue moves in brightness; one yang stirs; the ten thousand things live.

sentences.zh: 升中大報蒼璧陳，禮崇樂暢歆太清。

translations.literal: Ascending the middle great report, dark jade disk displayed; rites honored, music joyful, enjoying great clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending to the middle great report he displays the dark jade disk; rites are honored, music joyful, and great clarity is enjoyed.

sentences.zh: 星懸紫極，日麗璇庭，乾坤瑞氣盈，海宇安寧。

translations.literal: Stars suspended at purple pole; sun beautiful at jade court; heaven and earth auspicious qi full; seas and universe tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Stars hang at the purple pole; the sun is fair at the jade court; auspicious qi fills heaven and earth; seas and land are tranquil.

sentences.zh: 奏《撫安四夷舞曲》，其一，《賀聖朝》：華夷一統，萬國來同。

translations.literal: Performed "Dance of Pacifying the Four Yi," first, "Congratulating the Holy Court": Chinese and Yi one rule; ten thousand states come together.
translations.idiomatic: "Dance of Pacifying the Four Yi," first, "Congratulating the Holy Court": Chinese and Yi are one; ten thousand states come together.

sentences.zh: 獻方物，修庭貢，遠慕皇風，自南自北，自西自東。

translations.literal: Presenting local products; repairing court tribute; far admiring imperial wind; from south, from north, from west, from east.
translations.idiomatic: They present local products and repair court tribute, admiring the imperial wind from south, north, west, and east.

sentences.zh: 望天宮，佳氣鬱重重，四靈畢至，麟鳳龜龍。

translations.literal: Gazing at heaven palace; fine qi dense and layered; four numina all arrive — qilin, phoenix, tortoise, dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the heaven palace, fine qi lies dense in layers; qilin, phoenix, tortoise, and dragon — the four numina all arrive.

sentences.zh: 其二，《殿前歡》：瑞雲晴靄浮宮殿，一脈陽和轉。

translations.literal: Second, "Hall Delight": auspicious clouds, clear haze floating palace halls; one pulse of yang harmony turns.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Hall Delight": auspicious clouds and clear haze float over the palace halls as one pulse of yang harmony turns.

sentences.zh: 禮成交泰開周宴，鳳笙調，龍幄展，天心感格人歡忭，四海謳歌遍。

translations.literal: Rites accomplished, peace exchanged, opening Zhou banquet; phoenix sheng tuned; dragon canopy spread; heaven's heart feels and moves, people rejoice; the four seas songs of praise everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Rites accomplished and peace exchanged, the Zhou banquet opens; phoenix sheng is tuned and the dragon canopy spread; heaven's heart is moved and the people rejoice; songs of praise fill the four seas.

sentences.zh: 其三，《慶豐年》：賴皇天，錫豐年，勤禹稼，力舜田，喜慰三農願。

translations.literal: Third, "Celebrating Abundant Harvest": relying on bright heaven; bestowing abundant harvest; diligent in Yu's grain; strength in Shun's fields; joy comforting the three farmers' wish.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "Celebrating Abundant Harvest": relying on bright heaven's gift of harvest, diligent as Yu in grain and strong as Shun in the fields, they joyfully comfort the three farmers' wish.

sentences.zh: 嘉禾秀，瑞麥鮮，賦九州，貢八埏。

translations.literal: Fine grain splendid; auspicious wheat fresh; tribute from nine regions; presented from eight borders.
translations.idiomatic: Fine grain is splendid, the wheat auspicious and fresh; tribute comes from nine regions and is presented from eight borders.

sentences.zh: 神倉御廩咸充滿，養民以養賢。

translations.literal: Spirit granaries, imperial storehouses all full; nourishing the people to nourish the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit granaries and imperial storehouses are full; nourishing the people nourishes the worthy.

sentences.zh: 其四，《新水令》：聖德精禋格昊穹，大一統。

translations.literal: Fourth, "New Water Order": sage virtue refined sacrifice reaches the bright vault; great unity.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, "New Water Order": refined sacrifice of sage virtue reaches the bright vault; great unity.

sentences.zh: 四夷來貢，玉帛捧。

translations.literal: The four Yi come presenting tribute; jade and silk held high.
translations.idiomatic: The four Yi come with tribute; jade and silk are held high.

sentences.zh: 文軌同，世際昌隆，共聽輿人頌。

translations.literal: Writing and chariots united; generations meet flourishing prosperity; together hearing cart men's praise.
translations.idiomatic: Writing and chariots are one; generations meet in prosperity; together they hear the cart-men's praise.

sentences.zh: 其五，《太平令》：誕明禋，天鑑元后，光四表，惠澤周流。

translations.literal: Fifth, "Great Peace Command": manifesting bright sacrifice; heaven mirrors the primary consort; light the four quarters; grace spreading in weekly flow.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, "Great Peace Command": bright sacrifice is manifest; heaven mirrors the primary consort; her light fills the four quarters; grace flows week by week.

sentences.zh: 來四裔，趨前擁後，獻萬寶，充庭滿囿。

translations.literal: Coming from four frontiers; hurrying forward, crowding behind; presenting ten thousand treasures; filling court and park.
translations.idiomatic: From four frontiers they hurry forward and crowd behind, presenting ten thousand treasures that fill court and park.

sentences.zh: 稽首頓首，天高地厚，祝聖人，多男福壽。

translations.literal: Bowing head, pressing head; heaven high, earth thick; congratulating the sage person; many sons, blessing and longevity.
translations.idiomatic: Bow and press the head — heaven is high, earth is thick; they wish the sage many sons, blessing, and long life.

sentences.zh: 四奏《民樂生之曲》：大報禮初成，象乾德，運皇誠。

translations.literal: Fourth piece, "Melody of the People's Joy in Life": great report rites first accomplished; imageing qian virtue; moving imperial sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth piece, "Melody of the People's Joy in Life": the great report is first accomplished, imaging qian's virtue and moving imperial sincerity.

sentences.zh: 神州赤縣永清寧，靈雨和風樂太平。

translations.literal: Divine land, red counties forever clear and tranquil; spirit rain and harmonious wind rejoice in great peace.
translations.idiomatic: The divine land and red counties are forever clear and tranquil; spirit rain and harmonious wind rejoice in great peace.

sentences.zh: 陰陽交暢，品物咸亨，元化自流行，允殖羣生。

translations.literal: Yin and yang interchange smoothly; all things prosperous; primordial transformation self-moving; truly nourishing the multitude of living beings.
translations.idiomatic: Yin and yang interchange smoothly; all things prosper; primordial transformation moves of itself and truly nourishes the living multitude.

sentences.zh: 迎膳曲，《水龍吟》：五色祥雲捧玉皇，開閶闔，坐明光。

translations.literal: Welcoming banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": five-colored auspicious clouds supporting the Jade Emperor; opening heaven's gate; sitting in bright light.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming-banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": five-colored auspicious clouds support the Jade Emperor; heaven's gate opens; he sits in bright light.

sentences.zh: 鈞天樂奏，冬日御筵張。

translations.literal: Heaven music performed; winter day imperial banquet spread.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's music is performed; on a winter day the imperial banquet is spread.

sentences.zh: 文恬武熙，太平氣象，人在唐虞上。

translations.literal: Civil matters tranquil, martial matters glorious; great peace's appearance — people above Tang and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Civil affairs are calm and martial affairs resplendent; it is the visage of great peace — mankind surpasses Tang and Yu.

sentences.zh: 進膳曲，《水龍吟》：玉律陽回景運新，燕鎬京，藹皇仁。

translations.literal: Entering-banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": jade pitch, yang returns, fortune new; Yan and Hao capital; imperial grace spreads.
translations.idiomatic: Entering-banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": the jade pitch turns with returning yang and new fortune at Yan-Hao; imperial grace spreads abroad.

sentences.zh: 光昭雲漢，一氣沸韶韺。

translations.literal: Light shines on the cloudy Han; one qi boils shao and ying.
translations.idiomatic: Light floods the cloudy Milky Way; a single breath sets shao and ying ringing.

sentences.zh: 錦瑟和聲，瑤琴清韻，瞻仰天顏近。

translations.literal: Brocade se harmonizes sound; jade qin clear charm; gazing up at the heavenly countenance near.
translations.idiomatic: Brocade se and jade qin sound in harmony; they gaze up close upon the heavenly countenance.

sentences.zh: 進湯曲，《太清歌》：萬方民，樂時雍，鼓舞荷天工，雷行風動。

translations.literal: Soup melody, "Great Clarity Song": the ten thousand regions' people rejoice in timely harmony; drum and dance bear heaven's work; thunder moves, wind stirs.
translations.idiomatic: Soup melody, "Great Clarity Song": the people of ten thousand regions rejoice in timely harmony, drumming and dancing under heaven's hand as thunder moves and wind stirs.

sentences.zh: 喜今逢，南蠻北貊，東夷西戎，來朝貢。

translations.literal: Rejoicing to meet this day; southern Man, northern Mo, eastern Yi, western Rong come to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Rejoicing in this day: southern Man and northern Mo, eastern Yi and western Rong, all come to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 大明宮，星羅斗拱。

translations.literal: Great Bright Palace; stars range, Dipper arches.
translations.idiomatic: In the Great Bright Palace stars are ranged and the Dipper arches overhead.

sentences.zh: 九重天上六飛龍，五色雲間雙綵鳳，普天率土效華封，允協河清頌。

translations.literal: Six flying dragons on the ninefold heaven; five-colored clouds between, double brocade phoenix; all under heaven and within seas emulate Hua and Feng; truly harmonizing the He-clear hymn.
translations.idiomatic: Six dragons fly on the ninefold heaven; between five-colored clouds a double brocade phoenix; all within the seas emulate Hua and Feng — truly in harmony with the He-clear hymn.

sentences.zh: 奏《車書會同舞曲》，其一，《新水令》：五雲深護九重城，感洪恩。

translations.literal: Performed "Dance of Chariots and Writing United," first, "New Water Order": five clouds deeply guard the ninefold city; feeling great grace.
translations.idiomatic: "Dance of Chariots and Writing United," first, "New Water Order": five clouds deeply guard the ninefold city as men feel great grace.

sentences.zh: 一人有慶，陽初長，禮方行。

translations.literal: One man has celebration; yang first long; rites just proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: One man has cause for celebration; yang first lengthens; the rites are just underway.

sentences.zh: 帝德文明，表率邦家正。

translations.literal: Imperial virtue civilized; model for states and families upright.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial virtue is civilized; a model by which states and families are set upright.

sentences.zh: 其二，《水仙子》：萬方安堵樂康寧，九域同仁荷聖明。

translations.literal: The ten thousand regions secure and people peaceful; the nine domains together bear sage brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: The ten thousand regions are secure and the people peaceful; the nine domains together bear sage brilliance.

sentences.zh: 千年撫運承天命，露垂甘，河獻清，見雙岐秀麥連莖，喜靈雪隨冬應，睹祥雲拂曙生，神與化並運同行。

translations.literal: A thousand years bearing fortune, receiving heaven's mandate; dew hangs sweet, the river offers clarity; one sees double-stalked fine wheat in linked stems; gladly spirit snow answers winter; behold auspicious clouds brush dawn; spirit and transformation march together.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand years bearing fortune and heaven's mandate; sweet dew hangs and the river runs clear; double-stalked fine wheat appears in linked stems; spirit snow gladly answers winter; auspicious clouds brush the dawn — spirit and transformation march as one.

sentences.zh: 五奏《感皇恩之曲》：雙闕五星光，霓旌樹，紫蓋張。

translations.literal: Fifth piece, "Melody of Feeling Imperial Grace": twin gates, five stars' light; rainbow banners set; purple canopy spread.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth piece, "Melody of Feeling Imperial Grace": twin gates shine with five stars' light; rainbow banners are set and the purple canopy spread.

sentences.zh: 璇臺玉曆轉新陽，鈞天廣樂諧宮商。

translations.literal: Jade terrace, jade calendar turns new yang; jun heaven's broad music harmonizes gong and shang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jade terrace the jade calendar turns with new yang; jun heaven's broad music harmonizes gong and shang.

sentences.zh: 恩深露湛，喜溢霞觴，日月煥龍章，地久天長。

translations.literal: Grace deep, dew rich; joy overflows the rosy goblet; sun and moon brighten dragon insignia; earth long, heaven long.
translations.idiomatic: Grace runs deep, dew is rich; joy overflows the rosy goblet; sun and moon brighten the dragon insignia — may earth and heaven long endure.

sentences.zh: 奏《表正萬邦舞曲》，其一，《慶太平》：維天眷我聖明，禮圜丘，至德精誠。

translations.literal: Performed "Dance of Displaying Orthodoxy for Ten Thousand States," first, "Celebrating Great Peace": heaven favors our sage brilliance; rites at the circular altar; utmost virtue refined sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: "Dance of Displaying Orthodoxy for Ten Thousand States," first, "Celebrating Great Peace": heaven favors our sage brilliance; at the circular altar rites are performed in utmost refined sincerity.

sentences.zh: 乾元永清，洪膺景命，休徵應，泰階平。

translations.literal: Qian yuan forever clear; great reception of bright mandate; auspicious omens respond; great steps pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Qian yuan stands forever clear; the bright mandate is greatly received; auspicious omens answer; the great steps are pacified.

sentences.zh: 其二，《千秋歲》：聖主乘龍御萬邦，慶雲翔化日重光。

translations.literal: Second, "Thousand Autumns": the sage lord rides the dragon, ruling ten thousand states; celebratory clouds fly, transforming sun again bright.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Thousand Autumns": the sage lord rides the dragon and rules ten thousand states; celebratory clouds fly as the transforming sun shines anew.

sentences.zh: 羣臣拜舞稱壽觴，載歌《天保》章。

translations.literal: The multitude of ministers bow dance, raising longevity goblets; bearing the "Heaven Protects" piece.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers bow and dance, raising longevity goblets while bearing the "Heaven Protects" piece.

sentences.zh: 其三，《滾繡球》：五雲車，度九重，利見飛龍。

translations.literal: Third, "Rolling Embroidered Ball": five-cloud carriage crosses ninefold; profit seeing soaring dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "Rolling Embroidered Ball": the five-cloud carriage crosses the ninefold height; profit lies in seeing the soaring dragon.

sentences.zh: 耀袞章，火藻華蟲。

translations.literal: Radiant robes and insignia; fire algae, flowery insects.
translations.idiomatic: Radiant robes and insignia show fire-algae and flowery insects.

sentences.zh: 擊虎敔，考鳧鍾，鼉鼓逢逢。

translations.literal: Striking tiger drums; examining wild-geese bells; crocodile drums booming.
translations.idiomatic: They strike tiger drums and examine wild-geese bells; crocodile drums boom.

sentences.zh: 八珍列，九鼎豐隆。

translations.literal: Eight delicacies arrayed; nine tripods abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Eight delicacies are arrayed; nine tripods stand abundant.

sentences.zh: 堯眉揚彩舜重瞳，萬國咸熙四海雍，齊歌頌聖德神功。

translations.literal: Yao's brows raise color, Shun's double pupils; ten thousand states all prosperous, four seas harmonious; together singing sage virtue and divine achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Yao's brows lift with color, Shun's double pupils shine; ten thousand states prosper and four seas harmonize — together they sing sage virtue and divine achievement.

sentences.zh: 其四，《殿前歡》：萬年禮樂中興日，大化睹重熙。

translations.literal: Fourth, "Hall Delight": ten thousand years' ritual and music middle-revival day; great transformation beholds again flourishing harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, "Hall Delight": on the day of the middle revival of ten thousand years' ritual and music, great transformation again shows flourishing harmony.

sentences.zh: 河清海宴臻祥瑞，五行順，七政齊，超三邁五貞元會，既醉頌鳧鷖。

translations.literal: River clear, sea calm, reaching auspicious omens; five phases orderly, seven regulators aligned; surpassing three, exceeding five — the yuan meeting; drunk, they praise wild geese.
translations.idiomatic: River clear, sea calm — auspicious omens arrive; five phases orderly, seven regulators aligned; surpassing three and exceeding five at the yuan meeting, drunk they praise the wild geese.

sentences.zh: 其五，《天下樂》：萬靈朝拱接清都，享南郊，欽天法祖。

translations.literal: Fifth, "All Under Heaven Joy": ten thousand spirits bow and join the clear capital; enjoying the southern suburb; revering heaven, following ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, "All Under Heaven Joy": ten thousand spirits bow toward the clear capital; enjoying the southern suburb, revering heaven and following ancestors.

sentences.zh: 願聖人，承乾納祜，中和位育，龜獻範，馬陳圖。

translations.literal: May the sage person receive qian and accept blessing; central harmony position and nurture; tortoise presents model; horse presents diagram.
translations.idiomatic: May the sage receive qian and accept blessing; central harmony in position and nurture; the tortoise presents its model, the horse its diagram.

sentences.zh: 其六，《醉太平》：禮樂萬年規，謳歌四海熙。

translations.literal: Sixth, "Drunk Great Peace": ritual and music's ten-thousand-year rule; songs of praise, four seas prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, "Drunk Great Peace": the ten-thousand-year rule of ritual and music; songs of praise — four seas prosperous.

sentences.zh: 衣冠蹈舞九龍墀，麗正仰南離。

translations.literal: Robes and caps tread dance on the nine-dragon steps; Lizheng looks up to southern li.
translations.idiomatic: Robes and caps tread dance on the nine-dragon steps as Lizheng looks up to southern li.

sentences.zh: 紫雲高捧唐虞帝，垂衣天下文明治。

translations.literal: Purple clouds high uphold Tang-Yu emperor; draping robes, all under heaven civilly governed.
translations.idiomatic: Purple clouds high uphold the Tang-Yu emperor; draping robes, all under heaven is civilly governed.

sentences.zh: 鎬鳥岐鳳呈嘉瑞，真個是人在成周世。

translations.literal: Hao birds, Qi phoenix present auspicious omens; truly it is mankind in the age of accomplished Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hao birds and Qi phoenix present auspicious omens — truly mankind is in the age of accomplished Zhou.

sentences.zh: 六奏《慶豐年之曲》：聖人懋承乾，綏萬邦，屢豐年。

translations.literal: Sixth piece, "Melody of Celebrating Abundant Harvest": the sage person earnestly receives qian; soothing ten thousand states; repeatedly abundant years.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth piece, "Melody of Celebrating Abundant Harvest": the sage earnestly receives qian, soothes ten thousand states, and sees repeated abundant years.

sentences.zh: 神倉御廩登天田，明粢鬱鬯祀孔虔。

translations.literal: Spirit granaries, imperial storehouses ascend heaven's fields; bright grain, thick ale — sacrifice to the spirits most sincere.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit granaries and imperial storehouses ascend heaven's fields; bright grain and thick ale — sacrifice to the spirits most sincere.

sentences.zh: 輿情咸豫，協氣用宣，萬古帝圖傳，璧合珠聯。

translations.literal: Public sentiment all pleased; harmonious qi employed and proclaimed; ten thousand ages' imperial design transmitted; jade disks joined, pearls strung.
translations.idiomatic: Public sentiment is pleased; harmonious qi is employed and proclaimed; the imperial design of ten thousand ages is transmitted — jade disks joined, pearls strung.

sentences.zh: 七奏《集禎應之曲》：天保泰階平，寶露降，渾河清，喜禾秀麥集休禎，遐陬絕域喜氣盈。

translations.literal: Seventh piece, "Melody of Gathering Auspicious Responses": heaven protects, great steps pacified; precious dew descends; the whole river clear; rejoicing in fine grain and wheat gathering auspicious omens; remote corners and distant borders joyous qi full.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh piece, "Melody of Gathering Auspicious Responses": heaven protects, great steps pacified; precious dew descends, the whole river clear; fine grain and wheat gather auspicious omens; remote corners and distant borders brim with joyous qi.

sentences.zh: 一人有慶，百度惟貞，萬國頌咸寧，麗正重明。

translations.literal: One man has celebration; a hundred measures all correct; ten thousand states praise universal tranquility; Lizheng again bright.
translations.idiomatic: One man has celebration; a hundred measures are correct; ten thousand states praise universal tranquility; Lizheng is bright again.

sentences.zh: 八奏《永皇圖之曲》：鎬燕集天京，頌《魚藻》，歌《鹿鳴》。

translations.literal: Eighth piece, "Melody of Forever Securing the Imperial Design": Hao and Yan gather at heaven's capital; praising "Fish and Water"; singing "Deer Cry."
translations.idiomatic: Eighth piece, "Melody of Forever Securing the Imperial Design": Hao and Yan gather at heaven's capital, praising "Fish and Water" and singing "Deer Cry."

sentences.zh: 邊陲安堵萬國寧，重譯來庭四海清。

translations.literal: Border regions secure; ten thousand states tranquil; repeated translation comes to court; four seas clear.
translations.idiomatic: Border regions are secure; ten thousand states tranquil; through repeated translation they come to court; four seas clear.

sentences.zh: 咸池日曙，昧谷雲徵，帝座仰前星，豫大豐亨。

translations.literal: Xian pool sun dawn; Meigu cloud signs; imperial seat looks up to the former star; Yu great, Feng great.
translations.idiomatic: At Xian pool the sun dawns; at Meigu cloud signs appear; the imperial seat looks up to the former star — Yu great, Feng great.

sentences.zh: 九奏《樂太平之曲》：皇極永登祥，乾符啓，泰運昌。

translations.literal: Ninth piece, "Melody of Rejoicing in Great Peace": purple pole forever mounts auspiciousness; qian tally opens; great fortune flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth piece, "Melody of Rejoicing in Great Peace": the purple pole forever mounts auspiciousness; the qian tally opens; great fortune flourishes.

sentences.zh: 玉管回春動一陽，金鑾錫燕歌九章，虞庭獸舞，岐山鳳翊，日麗袞龍裳，主聖臣良。

translations.literal: Jade pipes return spring, moving one yang; golden palace bestowed banquet sings nine pieces; Yu court beast dance; Qishan phoenix assists; sun beautiful on dragon robes; lord sage, ministers good.
translations.idiomatic: Jade pipes return spring and move one yang; at the golden palace the bestowed banquet sings nine pieces; Yu court beast dance, Qishan phoenix assists; sun fair on dragon robes — lord sage, ministers good.

sentences.zh: 迎膳曲，《水龍吟》：香霧氤氳紫閣重，仰天德，瞻帝容。

translations.literal: Welcoming-banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": fragrant mist dense, purple pavilion heavy; looking up at heaven's virtue; gazing at emperor's countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming-banquet melody, "Water Dragon Chant": fragrant mist dense on the heavy purple pavilion; they look up at heaven's virtue and gaze at the emperor's countenance.

sentences.zh: 星輝海潤，甘雨間和風。

translations.literal: Stars' radiance, sea's moisture; sweet rain among harmonious wind.
translations.idiomatic: Stars' radiance and sea's moisture; sweet rain amid harmonious wind.

sentences.zh: 樂比鳶魚，瑞呈麟鳳，永獻《卷阿》頌。

translations.literal: Joy like kite fish; omens like qilin and phoenix; forever offering the "Juan E" praise.
translations.idiomatic: Joy like kite and fish; omens like qilin and phoenix; forever offering the "Juan E" praise.

sentences.zh: 進膳曲，其一，《水龍吟》：萬戶千門啓建章，臺階峻，帝座張。

translations.literal: Entering-banquet melody, first, "Water Dragon Chant": ten thousand doors and households open Jianzhang; terraces lofty; imperial seat spread.
translations.idiomatic: Entering-banquet melody, first, "Water Dragon Chant": ten thousand doors and households open Jianzhang; terraces lofty, imperial seat spread.

sentences.zh: 三垣九道，北斗玉衡光。

translations.literal: Three enclosures, nine ways; Northern Dipper, jade balance light.
translations.idiomatic: Three enclosures, nine ways; the Northern Dipper and jade balance shine.

sentences.zh: 元氣調和，雅韻鏗鏘，昭代慶明良。

translations.literal: Primordial qi harmonious; elegant charm clanging; bright age celebrates enlightened goodness.
translations.idiomatic: Primordial qi is harmonious; elegant charm rings; the bright age celebrates enlightened goodness.

sentences.zh: 其二，《太清歌》：萬方國，盡來庭。

translations.literal: Entering-banquet melody, second, "Great Clarity Song": ten thousand regions' states all come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Entering-banquet melody, second, "Great Clarity Song": the states of ten thousand regions all come to court.

sentences.zh: 稽首歌帝仁，仰荷生成。

translations.literal: Bowing head singing emperor's benevolence; looking up bearing generation.
translations.idiomatic: Bow the head singing the emperor's benevolence; look up bearing what generation has made.

sentences.zh: 振乾綱，陰陽順序，民物樂生。

translations.literal: Stirring qian net; yin and yang orderly sequence; people and things rejoice in life.
translations.idiomatic: Stirring the qian net; yin and yang in orderly sequence; people and things rejoice in life.

sentences.zh: 逢明聖，萬年春，永膺休命。

translations.literal: Meeting the bright sage; ten thousand years spring; forever receiving fine mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting the bright sage — ten thousand years of spring; forever receiving the fine mandate.

sentences.zh: 華夷蠻僚咸歸正，蒼生至老不知兵，鼓腹含哺囿太平，九有享清寧。

translations.literal: Chinese and Yi, Man and Liao all return to orthodoxy; common people to old age know not arms; drumming belly, holding mouth in garden of great peace; nine regions enjoy clear tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese and Yi, Man and Liao all return to orthodoxy; the common people to old age know not arms; drumming the belly and holding the mouth in the garden of great peace — nine regions enjoy clear tranquility.

sentences.zh: 奏《天命有德舞曲》，其一，《萬歲樂》：太平天子興隆日，履初長，陽回元吉。

translations.literal: Performed "Mandate of Heaven Has Virtue Dance," first, "Ten Thousand Years Joy": great peace Son of Heaven flourishing day; treading first long; yang returns, primordial auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: "Mandate of Heaven Has Virtue Dance," first, "Ten Thousand Years Joy": on the great peace Son of Heaven's flourishing day, treading first long, yang returns in primordial auspiciousness.

sentences.zh: 醴泉芝草休徵集，曾聞道五星聚室。

translations.literal: Sweet spring, spirit grass, auspicious omens gather; once heard that five stars gathered in the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet spring and spirit grass — auspicious omens gather; once it was heard that five stars gathered in the chamber.

sentences.zh: 其二，《賀聖朝》：一人元良，百度維新。

translations.literal: Second, "Congratulating the Holy Court": one man, the heir, a hundred measures new.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Congratulating the Holy Court": one man, the heir; a hundred measures made new.

sentences.zh: 握赤符，凝玄應，享太清。

translations.literal: Holding the red tally; condensing dark response; enjoying great clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Holding the red tally, condensing dark response, enjoying great clarity.

sentences.zh: 大禮方行，祀事孔明感天心，億載恆承慶。

translations.literal: Great rites just proceeding; sacrificial affairs clear and bright, feeling heaven's heart; a hundred million ages forever receiving celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Great rites are just proceeding; sacrificial affairs clear and bright, feeling heaven's heart — a hundred million ages forever receiving celebration.

sentences.zh: 明王慎德，四裔咸賓。

translations.literal: Bright king careful in virtue; four frontiers all guests.
translations.idiomatic: The bright king is careful in virtue; four frontiers are all guests.

sentences.zh: 奏《纓鞭得勝蠻夷隊舞承應曲》，其一，《醉太平》：星華紫殿高，雲氣彤樓繞。

translations.literal: Performed "Tassel Whip Victorious Barbarian Formation Dance" responsive melody, first, "Drunk Great Peace": star flowers, purple hall high; cloud qi, red tower coiling.
translations.idiomatic: "Tassel Whip Victorious Barbarian Formation Dance" responsive melody, first, "Drunk Great Peace": star-flowers on the high purple hall; cloud-qi coiling round the red tower.

sentences.zh: 九夷重譯梯航到，皇圖光八表。

translations.literal: Nine Yi repeated translation, ladder ships arrive; imperial design light, eight regions' surface.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Yi through repeated translation, ladder-ships arrive; imperial design lights the eight regions' face.

sentences.zh: 玉宇無塵明月皎，銀河自轉扶桑曉，平平蕩蕩歸王道。

translations.literal: Jade universe without dust; bright moon clear; Milky Way self-turns; fusang dawn; level and vast returning to the royal way.
translations.idiomatic: The jade universe without dust; bright moon clear; the Milky Way turns of itself at fusang dawn; level and vast, returning to the royal way.

sentences.zh: 百獸舞，鳳鳴簫韶。

translations.literal: Hundred beasts dance; phoenix cries, xiao and shao.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred beasts dance; the phoenix cries with xiao and shao.

sentences.zh: 其二，《看花會》：普天下，都賴吾皇至聖。

translations.literal: Second, "Flower-Gathering Meeting": throughout the realm all rely on our emperor's utmost sage.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Flower-Gathering Meeting": throughout the realm all rely on our emperor's utmost sage.

sentences.zh: 看玉關頻款，天山已定。

translations.literal: See Jade Gate frequently sincere; Tianshan already settled.
translations.idiomatic: See Jade Gate frequently sincere; Tianshan is already settled.

sentences.zh: 四夷效順歸王命。

translations.literal: The four Yi submit in effect, return to the king's command.
translations.idiomatic: The four Yi submit in effect and return to the king's command.

sentences.zh: 《天保》歌，羣黎百姓。

translations.literal: "Heaven Protects" song; the multitude of common people.
translations.idiomatic: The "Heaven Protects" song — the multitude of common people.

sentences.zh: 其三，《天下樂》：九重樂奏萬花開，望龍樓，雲蒸霧靄。

translations.literal: Third, "All Under Heaven Joy": ninefold music performed, ten thousand flowers open; gazing at dragon tower; clouds steam, mist dense.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "All Under Heaven Joy": ninefold music performed, ten thousand flowers open; gazing at the dragon tower — clouds steam, mist dense.

sentences.zh: 仰天工，雍熙帝載，臣民歡戴。

translations.literal: Looking up at heaven's work; flourishing harmony, emperor's carriage; subjects and people gladly wear it.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up at heaven's work — flourishing harmony, the emperor's carriage; subjects and people gladly wear it.

sentences.zh: 溥仁恩，遍九垓。

translations.literal: Broad benevolent grace pervades the nine regions.
translations.idiomatic: Broad benevolent grace pervades the nine regions.

sentences.zh: 其四，《清江引》：黃鐘既奏陽和長，德盛天心貺。

translations.literal: Fourth, "Clear River Prelude": yellow bell already performed; yang harmony long; virtue prosperous, heaven's heart bestows.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, "Clear River Prelude": yellow bell already performed; yang harmony long; virtue prosperous — heaven's heart bestows.

sentences.zh: 人文日月明，國勢山河壯，衢室民謠頻擊壤。

translations.literal: Human culture, sun and moon bright; state power, mountains and rivers majestic; Quarters chamber people's ballad frequently beats clods.
translations.idiomatic: Human culture and sun and moon bright; state power and mountains and rivers majestic; in the Quarters chamber people's ballads frequently beat the clods.

sentences.zh: 奏致語曲，其一，《清江引》：鈞天畢奏日方中，既醉歡聲動。

translations.literal: Performed address melody, first, "Clear River Prelude": jun heaven finished performing, sun just at center; already drunk, joyous sound moves.
translations.idiomatic: Address melody, first, "Clear River Prelude": jun heaven finished performing, sun just at center; already drunk, joyous sound moves.

sentences.zh: 雲章傍袞龍，飆勢翔威鳳，萬方安樂興嘉頌。

translations.literal: Cloud writing beside dragon robes; wind momentum soaring, awesome phoenix; ten thousand regions peaceful, rejoicing in fine praise.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud writing beside dragon robes; wind-momentum soaring, awesome phoenix; ten thousand regions peaceful, rejoicing in fine praise.

sentences.zh: 其二，《千秋歲》：上下交歡燕禮成，一陽奮，萬匯咸亨。

translations.literal: Second, "Thousand Autumns": above and below interchange rejoicing; banquet rites accomplished; one yang striving; ten thousand things all prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Thousand Autumns": above and below interchange in rejoicing; banquet rites accomplished; one yang strives; ten thousand things all prosperous.

sentences.zh: 風雲會合開明運，紫極轉璇衡。

translations.literal: Wind and clouds meet and join, opening enlightened fortune; purple pole turns jade balance.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and clouds meet and join, opening enlightened fortune; the purple pole turns the jade balance.

sentences.zh: 宴畢，百官行禮曲，《朝天子》：文班武班，歡動承明殿，禮成樂備頌聲喧。

translations.literal: Banquet finished; hundred officials performing obeisance melody, "Facing Heaven": civil ranks, martial ranks; rejoicing moves Chenming Hall; rites accomplished, music prepared, praise sound clamorous.
translations.idiomatic: Banquet finished; officials' obeisance melody, "Facing Heaven": civil and martial ranks; rejoicing moves Chenming Hall; rites accomplished, music prepared, praise clamorous.

sentences.zh: 真咫尺，仰天顏，日照龍筵。

translations.literal: Truly within reach; looking up at heavenly countenance; sun shines on dragon banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Truly within reach; looking up at the heavenly countenance; sun shines on the dragon banquet.

sentences.zh: 風回雉扇翠蕤旋，奉仙鑾，雲間鬥間，五色金章燦。

translations.literal: Wind returns, pheasant fans, kingfisher whirling; bearing immortal carriage; between clouds and Dipper; five colors, golden insignia brilliant.
translations.idiomatic: Wind returns; pheasant fans and kingfisher whirling; bearing the immortal carriage between clouds and Dipper; five colors, golden insignia brilliant.

sentences.zh: 還宮曲，《萬歲樂》：天回北極雲成瑞，望層霄，重華日麗。

translations.literal: Returning to palace melody, "Ten Thousand Years Joy": heaven turns; north pole clouds become omens; gazing at layered skies; again a day of double splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Returning-palace melody, "Ten Thousand Years Joy": heaven turns; north pole clouds become omens; gazing at layered skies — again a day of double splendor.

sentences.zh: 九垓八極樂雍熙，祝聖壽，萬萬歲。

translations.literal: Nine regions, eight poles rejoice in flourishing harmony; congratulating sage longevity ten thousand myriad years.
translations.idiomatic: Nine regions, eight poles rejoice in flourishing harmony. congratulating sage longevity ten thousand myriad years.

sentences.zh: 永樂間小宴樂章。

translations.literal: Small-banquet music of the Yongle period.
translations.idiomatic: Small-banquet music of the Yongle period.

sentences.zh: 一奏《本太初之曲》，《朝天子》：混兮沌兮，水土成元氣，不分南北與東西，未辨天和地。

translations.literal: First piece, "Melody of This Primal Beginning," "Facing Heaven": mixed, chaotic — water and earth formed primordial qi; not distinguishing north, south, east, west; not yet discerning heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: First piece, "Melody of This Primal Beginning," "Facing Heaven": mixed and chaotic — water and earth formed primordial qi, not yet distinguishing north, south, east, or west, not yet discerning heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 萬象包涵，其中祕密，難窮造化機，是陰陽本體。

translations.literal: Ten thousand images inclusive; within them secrets; hard to exhaust creation's mechanism — this is yin and yang's substance.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand images are inclusive; secrets within are hard to exhaust — this is the substance of yin and yang.

sentences.zh: 乃爲之太極，兩儀因而立。

translations.literal: Then for it the supreme pole; two forms thereby established.
translations.idiomatic: Then came the supreme pole; the two forms were thereby established.

sentences.zh: 二奏《仰大明之曲》，《歸朝歡》：太極分，混然方始見儀形，清浮濁偃乾坤定。

translations.literal: Second piece, "Melody of Looking Up to Great Brightness," "Returning Court Joy": supreme pole divided; mixed, then first saw ritual form; clear floating, turbid reclining — heaven and earth fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Second piece, "Melody of Looking Up to Great Brightness," "Returning Court Joy": the supreme pole divided; in the mix ritual form first appeared; the clear floated, the turbid reclined — heaven and earth were fixed.

sentences.zh: 日月齊興，照青霄，萬象明。

translations.literal: Sun and moon together rise; shining the azure sky; ten thousand images bright.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon together rise, shining the azure sky; ten thousand images bright.

sentences.zh: 陽須動，陰須靜，陰與陽，皆相應。

translations.literal: Yang must move; yin must be still; yin and yang all mutually respond.
translations.idiomatic: Yang must move, yin must be still — yin and yang all respond to one another.

sentences.zh: 流行二氣，萬物俱生。

translations.literal: Circulating the two qi; ten thousand things all live.
translations.idiomatic: Circulating the two qi, ten thousand things all live.

sentences.zh: 三奏《民初生之曲》，其一，《沽美酒》：乾坤清，宇宙寧，六合淨，四維正，萬象原來一氣生。

translations.literal: Third piece, "Melody of the People's First Birth," first, "Buying Fine Wine": heaven and earth clear; universe tranquil; six harmonies pure; four dimensions upright; ten thousand images originally one qi born.
translations.idiomatic: Third piece, "Melody of the People's First Birth," first, "Buying Fine Wine": heaven and earth clear, universe tranquil; six harmonies pure, four dimensions upright; ten thousand images born originally of one qi.

sentences.zh: 定三才五行，民與物，共成羣。

translations.literal: Fixing three talents, five phases; people and things together form groups.
translations.idiomatic: Fixing the three talents and five phases, people and things together form groups.

sentences.zh: 其二，《太平令》：爲一類不分人品，竟生食豈曉庖烹，避寒暑巢居穴遁，披樹葉相尋趁，如何是愛親。

translations.literal: Second, "Great Peace Command": as one kind not distinguishing people's ranks; all eating raw, how knowing cooking; avoiding cold and heat, nest-dwelling, cave-hiding; wearing tree leaves, seeking each other — how is loving kin?
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Great Peace Command": as one kind they did not distinguish ranks; eating raw, how could they know cooking? Avoiding cold and heat they nested in caves, wore tree leaves and sought one another — how was loving kin?

sentences.zh: 世情治生。

translations.literal: Worldly feeling, governing life.
translations.idiomatic: Worldly feeling governed life.

sentences.zh: 雖混然各安其性。

translations.literal: Though mixed, each settled their nature.
translations.idiomatic: Though mixed, each settled their nature.

sentences.zh: 四奏《品物亨之曲》，《醉太平》：黎民生世間，萬物長塵寰，陰陽交運轉循環，久遠時庶繁。

translations.literal: Fourth piece, "Melody of All Things Prosperous," "Drunk Great Peace": common people live in the world; ten thousand things grow in the dusty realm; yin and yang interchange in circulation; long distant, times numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth piece, "Melody of All Things Prosperous," "Drunk Great Peace": common people live in the world; ten thousand things grow in the dusty realm; yin and yang interchange in long circulation through numerous times.

sentences.zh: 相傳氣候應無間，品物交錯憑誰鑑。

translations.literal: Mutually transmitting, seasons and qi responding without interval; things interweaving — by whom appraised?
translations.idiomatic: Mutually transmitting, seasons and qi respond without interval; things interweave — by whom appraised?

sentences.zh: 望聖人出世整江山，主萬民得安。

translations.literal: Looking for the sage person born to the world, putting in order rivers and mountains; ruling ten thousand people obtaining peace.
translations.idiomatic: Looking for the sage person born into the world to put rivers and mountains in order and give ten thousand people peace.

sentences.zh: 五奏《御六龍之曲》，其一，《清江引》：人心久仰生聖君，天使人生聖。

translations.literal: Fifth piece, "Melody of Driving Six Dragons," first, "Clear River Prelude": people's hearts long looked up — the sage lord born; heaven's messenger, man born sage.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth piece, "Melody of Driving Six Dragons," first, "Clear River Prelude": people's hearts long looked up for the sage lord born; heaven's messenger — man born sage.

sentences.zh: 聖人受天機，體天居中正，御六龍，驛明登九重。

translations.literal: The sage receives heaven's mechanism; body heaven, dwelling center and correctness; driving six dragons, post-houses bright, ascending ninefold.
translations.idiomatic: The sage receives heaven's mechanism; embodies heaven, dwells in center and correctness; drives six dragons, post-houses bright, ascends the ninefold height.

sentences.zh: 其二，《碧玉簫》：君坐神京，海嶽共從新。

translations.literal: Second, "Jade Bamboo Flute": lord sits divine capital; seas and mountains together follow anew.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Jade Bamboo Flute": the lord sits in the divine capital; seas and mountains together follow anew.

sentences.zh: 民仰君恩，聖治有人倫。

translations.literal: People look up at lord's grace; sage governance has human relations.
translations.idiomatic: The people look up at the lord's grace; sage governance has its human relations.

sentences.zh: 人品分，萬物增，聖承乾，百福臻。

translations.literal: Human ranks distinguished; ten thousand things increase; sage receives qian; hundred blessings arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Human ranks are distinguished; ten thousand things increase; the sage receives qian; hundred blessings arrive.

sentences.zh: 垂法明，尊天命，興後朝，皆從正。

translations.literal: Spreading law bright; revering heaven's mandate; raising later courts — all follow correctness.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading law bright; revering heaven's mandate; later courts all follow correctness.

sentences.zh: 六奏《泰階平之曲》，《十二月》：聖乃有言天，天是無言聖。

translations.literal: Sixth piece, "Melody of Great Steps Pacified," "Twelve Months": the sage then has words — heaven is wordless sage.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth piece, "Melody of Great Steps Pacified," "Twelve Months": the sage has words — heaven is the wordless sage.

sentences.zh: 聖人臨正，萬物亨通，恩威盛，社稷安，仁德感，江山定。

translations.literal: Sage faces correctness; ten thousand things prosperous; grace and awe flourishing; altars secure; benevolent virtue felt; rivers and mountains fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The sage faces correctness; ten thousand things prosper; grace and awe flourish; altars are secure; benevolent virtue is felt; rivers and mountains are fixed.

sentences.zh: 選用英賢興王政，分善惡賞罰均平。

translations.literal: Selecting and employing worthy heroes, raising royal government; distinguishing good and evil, rewards and punishments even.
translations.idiomatic: Selecting worthy heroes and raising royal government; distinguishing good and evil, rewards and punishments even.

sentences.zh: 三公九卿，左右股肱，庶事康寧。

translations.literal: Three dukes, nine ministers, left and right arms and thighs; multitude of affairs peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Three dukes and nine ministers, left and right arms and thighs — multitude of affairs peaceful.

sentences.zh: 七奏《君德成之曲》，其一，《十二月》：皇基以興，聖帝修身，奉天體道，聖德愈明。

translations.literal: Seventh piece, "Melody of Lord's Virtue Accomplished," first, "Twelve Months": imperial foundation thereby rises; sage emperor cultivates body; bearing heaven, embodying way; sage virtue ever brighter.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh piece, "Melody of Lord's Virtue Accomplished," first, "Twelve Months": imperial foundation rises; the sage emperor cultivates his person, bearing heaven and embodying the Way — sage virtue ever brighter.

sentences.zh: 敬天地，勤勞萬民；

translations.literal: Revering heaven and earth; toiling for ten thousand people;
translations.idiomatic: Revering heaven and earth; toiling for the ten thousand people;

sentences.zh: 立法度，上下咸寧。

translations.literal: Establishing laws and standards; above and below all tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing laws and standards. above and below all tranquil.

sentences.zh: 其二《堯民歌》：風俗禮樂厚彝倫，爰興學校進儒經，賢臣良將保朝廷，四野人民頌歡聲。

translations.literal: Second, "Yao Folk Song": customs, ritual, music thick in constant norms; then raising schools, advancing Confucian classics; worthy ministers, good generals protect the court; four wilds' people praise rejoicing sound.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Yao Folk Song": customs and ritual music thick in constant norms; schools are raised and Confucian classics advanced; worthy ministers and good generals protect the court; the four wilds praise with rejoicing sound.

sentences.zh: 用的是賢英，賢英定太平，寰海皆歸正。

translations.literal: Using is worthy heroes; worthy heroes fix great peace; seas and universe all return to correctness.
translations.idiomatic: What is used is worthy heroes; worthy heroes fix great peace; seas and universe all return to correctness.

sentences.zh: 八奏《聖道行之曲》，其一，《金殿萬年歡》：三綱既定，九疇復興。

translations.literal: Eighth piece, "Melody of Sage Way Proceeding," first, "Golden Hall Ten Thousand Years Joy": three guidelines already fixed; nine categories again rise.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth piece, "Melody of Sage Way Proceeding," first, "Golden Hall Ten Thousand Years Joy": three guidelines already fixed; nine categories rise again.

sentences.zh: 聖道如天，嘉禾齊秀，寒暑和平。

translations.literal: Sage way like heaven; fine grain together splendid; cold and heat peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: The sage way is like heaven; fine grain together splendid; cold and heat peaceful.

sentences.zh: 聖威無邊皇基穩，勝磐石，慶雲生。

translations.literal: Sage awe without boundary; imperial foundation firm; surpassing rock; celebratory clouds born.
translations.idiomatic: Sage awe without boundary; imperial foundation firm, surpassing rock; celebratory clouds born.

sentences.zh: 景星長現，三光輝耀，百穀收成，萬姓安寧。

translations.literal: Auspicious stars long appear; three luminaries shine; hundred grains harvest; ten thousand surnames tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious stars long appear; three luminaries shine

sentences.zh: 其二，《得勝令》：聖德感皇乾，甘露降山川。

translations.literal: Second, "Victory Command": sage virtue moves imperial qian; sweet dew descends mountains and streams.
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Victory Command": sage virtue moves imperial qian; sweet dew descends on mountains and streams.

sentences.zh: 萬邦來朝貢，奇珍擺佈全，玉階下鳴鞭。

translations.literal: Ten thousand states come to court with tribute; rare treasures arrayed complete; below jade steps whip sounds.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand states come to court with tribute; rare treasures arrayed complete; below jade steps the whip sounds.

sentences.zh: 仰聖主，升金殿，丹墀列英賢，贊吾皇，豐稔年。

translations.literal: Looking up at sage lord ascending golden hall; cinnabar steps array outstanding heroes; praising our emperor; abundant harvest year.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up at the sage lord ascending the golden hall; on cinnabar steps outstanding heroes array; praising our emperor — an abundant harvest year.

sentences.zh: 九奏《樂清寧之曲》，其一，《普天樂》：萬邦寧，皇圖正。

translations.literal: Ninth piece, "Melody of Music Clear and Tranquil," first, "Universal Heaven Joy": ten thousand states tranquil; imperial design correct.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth piece, "Melody of Music Clear and Tranquil," first, "Universal Heaven Joy": ten thousand states tranquil. imperial design correct.

sentences.zh: 父君母后，天下咸欽。

translations.literal: Father sovereign, mother consort; all under heaven together admire.
translations.idiomatic: Father sovereign, mother consort — all under heaven together admire.

sentences.zh: 君治外，永聖明；

translations.literal: Lord governs outside; forever sage bright;
translations.idiomatic: The lord governs outside — forever sage and bright;

sentences.zh: 後治內，長安靜。

translations.literal: Consort governs inside; long peace and tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: The consort governs inside — long peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 後聖承乾皆從正，德相傳，聖子神孫。

translations.literal: Later sage receives qian, all follow correctness; virtue mutually transmitted; sage son, divine grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Later sage receives qian, all follow correctness; virtue mutually transmitted — sage son, divine grandson.

sentences.zh: 天威浩蕩，江山永固，洪福無窮。

translations.literal: Heaven's awe vast and sweeping; rivers and mountains forever firm; great blessing without end.
