translations.idiomatic: Heaven's awe vast and sweeping; rivers and mountains forever firm

sentences.zh: 其二，《沽美酒》：和氣生，滿玉京；

translations.literal: Second, "Buying Fine Wine": harmonious qi born; filling jade capital;
translations.idiomatic: Second, "Buying Fine Wine": harmonious qi is born, filling the jade capital;

sentences.zh: 祥煙起，映皇宮。

translations.literal: Auspicious smoke arises; reflecting imperial palace.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious smoke arises, reflecting the imperial palace.

sentences.zh: 明聖開基整萬民，風雲會帝庭。

translations.literal: Bright sage opens foundation, putting in order ten thousand people; wind and clouds meet at emperor's court.
translations.idiomatic: Bright sage opens the foundation, putting ten thousand people in order; wind and clouds meet at the emperor's court.

sentences.zh: 奏簫韶，九韻成。

translations.literal: Performing xiao and shao; nine charms accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Performing xiao and shao. nine charms accomplished.

sentences.zh: 其三，《太平令》：紫霧隱金鸞綵鳳，祥光罩良將賢臣。

translations.literal: Third, "Great Peace Command": purple mist hides golden luan, brocade phoenix; auspicious light covers good generals, worthy ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Third, "Great Peace Command": purple mist hides golden luan and brocade phoenix; auspicious light covers good generals and worthy ministers.

sentences.zh: 玉案列珍羞美醞，寶鼎爇龍涎香噴。

translations.literal: Jade table arrays rare delicacies, fine brew; precious tripod burns dragon saliva fragrance spraying.
translations.idiomatic: Jade table arrays rare delicacies and fine brew; precious tripod burns dragon-saliva fragrance.

sentences.zh: 至尊永寧，儲嗣守成，賀萬萬歲一人有慶。

translations.literal: Supreme forever tranquil; heir preserves accomplishment; congratulating ten thousand myriad years — one man has celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme forever tranquil; heir preserves accomplishment

sentences.zh: 右二奏至八奏，俱奏百戲承應；

translations.literal: From the second through eighth pieces, all performed hundred plays in response;
translations.idiomatic: From the second through eighth pieces, all performed hundred plays in response;

sentences.zh: 第九奏，《魚躍於淵》承應。

translations.literal: Ninth piece, "Fish Leaping in the Deep" in response.
translations.idiomatic: the ninth piece, "Fish Leaping in the Deep," in response.

sentences.zh: 奉天門宴百官，止用《本太初》、《仰大明》、《民初生》三奏曲，其進酒、進膳樂同。

translations.literal: Fengtian Gate banquet for hundred officials — only used "This Primal Beginning," "Great Brightness," "People's First Birth" three performance pieces; entering wine and entering banquet music same.
translations.idiomatic: At Fengtian Gate's banquet for hundred officials — only "This Primal Beginning," "Great Brightness," and "People's First Birth" were used; entering-wine and entering-banquet music were the same.

sentences.zh: 惟百官叩頭禮，用《朝天子》曲。

translations.literal: Only hundred officials' kowtow rites used "Facing Heaven" piece.
translations.idiomatic: Only for officials' kowtow rites was the "Facing Heaven" piece used.

sentences.zh: 宴畢，導駕還宮，用《御鑾歌》。

translations.literal: Banquet finished; guiding carriage returning to palace used "Imperial Carriage Song."
translations.idiomatic: When the banquet finished, guiding the carriage back to the palace used "Imperial Carriage Song."

sentences.zh: 嘉靖間仁壽宮落成宴饗樂章。

translations.literal: During Jiajing, music for the Benevolence-Longevity Palace completion banquet and feast.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign, music was set for the banquet celebrating the completion of the Benevolence-Longevity Palace.

sentences.zh: 一奏《本太初之曲》，《朝天子》：帝誠帝明，寶位基昌命。

translations.literal: First piece, "This Primal Beginning," "Facing Heaven": emperor sincere, emperor bright; precious position foundation, prosperous mandate.
translations.idiomatic: First piece, "This Primal Beginning," "Facing Heaven": emperor sincere, emperor bright; precious position's foundation, prosperous mandate.

sentences.zh: 仙苑開筵歌《鹿鳴》，亭殿天章映。

translations.literal: Immortal garden opens banquet, singing "Deer Cry"; pavilion halls heaven's writing reflected.
translations.idiomatic: Immortal garden opens banquet, singing "Deer Cry"; pavilion halls reflect heaven's writing.

sentences.zh: 我有嘉賓，鼓瑟吹笙。

translations.literal: I have fine guests; se and sheng played.
translations.idiomatic: I have fine guests; se and sheng are played.
